            why: "减少执行时间和外部调用以降低成本"
        }
    },
    
    // 无服务器 Change Streams 处理器框架
    serverlessChangeStreamsFramework: `
        // 无服务器环境下的 Change Streams 处理器框架
        class ServerlessChangeStreamProcessor {
            constructor(config) {
                this.config = {
                    maxProcessingTime: config.maxProcessingTime || 300000, // 5分钟
                    checkpointInterval: config.checkpointInterval || 1000, // 每1000个事件
                    checkpointWindow: config.checkpointWindow || 60000, // 60秒
                    batchSize: config.batchSize || 100,
                    ...config
                };
                
                this.state = {
                    processedCount: 0,
                    lastCheckpoint: null,
                    lastResumeToken: null,
                    startTime: null
                };
                
                this.eventHandlers = new Map();
            }
            
            // 注册事件处理器
            registerHandler(operationType, handler) {
                if (!this.eventHandlers.has(operationType)) {
                    this.eventHandlers.set(operationType, []);
                }
                this.eventHandlers.get(operationType).push(handler);
            }
            
            // 主处理循环
            async processStream(changeStream) {
                this.state.startTime = Date.now();
                
                try {
                    while (this.shouldContinue()) {
                        if (await changeStream.hasNext()) {
                            const change = await changeStream.next();
                            
                            // 处理事件
                            await this.processChange(change);
                            
                            // 更新状态
                            this.state.processedCount++;
                            this.state.lastResumeToken = change._id;
                            
                            // 定期检查点
                            if (this.shouldCheckpoint()) {
                                await this.createCheckpoint();
                            }
                        }
                    }
                    
                    // 时间到，创建最终检查点
                    await this.createCheckpoint(true);
                    
                } catch (error) {
                    console.error('Error in stream processing:', error);
                    
                    // 尝试保存进度
                    try {
                        await this.createCheckpoint(true);
                    } catch (checkpointError) {
                        console.error('Failed to create checkpoint:', checkpointError);
                    }
                    
                    throw error;
                }
            }
            
            shouldContinue() {
                const elapsed = Date.now() - this.state.startTime;
                return elapsed < this.config.maxProcessingTime;
            }
            
            shouldCheckpoint() {
                if (!this.state.lastCheckpoint) {
                    return true;
                }
                
                const timeSinceCheckpoint = Date.now() - this.state.lastCheckpoint.time;
                const countSinceCheckpoint = this.state.processedCount - 
                                            (this.state.lastCheckpoint.count || 0);
                
                return timeSinceCheckpoint > this.config.checkpointWindow || 
                       countSinceCheckpoint > this.config.checkpointInterval;
            }
            
            async processChange(change) {
                const handlers = this.eventHandlers.get(change.operationType) || [];
                
                // 并行执行所有处理器
                await Promise.all(
                    handlers.map(handler => this.safeExecuteHandler(handler, change))
                );
            }
            
            async safeExecuteHandler(handler, change) {
                try {
                    await handler(change);
                } catch (error) {
                    console.error(`Handler failed for ${change.operationType}:`, error);
                    
                    // 记录错误但不停止处理
                    await this.recordHandlerError(handler.name, change, error);
                    
                    // 根据错误类型决定是否重试
                    if (this.isRetryableHandlerError(error)) {
                        // 可以加入重试队列
                        await this.enqueueForRetry(handler, change, error);
                    }
                }
            }
            
            async createCheckpoint(isFinal = false) {
                if (!this.state.lastResumeToken) {
                    return;
                }
                
                const checkpoint = {
                    resumeToken: this.state.lastResumeToken,
                    processedCount: this.state.processedCount,
                    timestamp: new Date(),
                    isFinal: isFinal
                };
                
                // 保存到持久化存储
                await this.saveCheckpoint(checkpoint);
                
                this.state.lastCheckpoint = {
                    token: this.state.lastResumeToken,
                    count: this.state.processedCount,
                    time: Date.now()
                };
                
                console.log(`Created checkpoint: ${this.state.processedCount} events processed`);
            }
            
            async saveCheckpoint(checkpoint) {
                // 保存检查点到持久化存储
                // 实现取决于具体基础设施
                
                // 示例：保存到 MongoDB
                const db = this.getDatabase();
                await db.collection('change_stream_checkpoints').updateOne(
                    { processorId: this.config.processorId },
                    { 
                        $set: {
                            ...checkpoint,
                            updatedAt: new Date()
                        }
                    },
                    { upsert: true }
                );
            }
            
            async loadCheckpoint() {
                // 从持久化存储加载检查点
                try {
                    const db = this.getDatabase();
                    const checkpoint = await db.collection('change_stream_checkpoints')
                        .findOne({ processorId: this.config.processorId });
                    
                    if (checkpoint) {
                        this.state.lastResumeToken = checkpoint.resumeToken;
                        this.state.processedCount = checkpoint.processedCount || 0;
                        return checkpoint.resumeToken;
                    }
                } catch (error) {
                    console.error('Failed to load checkpoint:', error);
                }
                
                return null;
            }
            
            getDatabase() {
                // 获取数据库连接
                // 实现取决于具体配置
                throw new Error('getDatabase() must be implemented');
            }
            
            isRetryableHandlerError(error) {
                // 判断处理器错误是否可重试
                const retryableErrors = [
                    'NetworkError',
                    'TimeoutError',
                    'TemporaryUnavailable'
                ];
                
                return retryableErrors.some(retryable => 
                    error.message?.includes(retryable) || 
                    error.name?.includes(retryable)
                );
            }
            
            async recordHandlerError(handlerName, change, error) {
                // 记录处理器错误
                const db = this.getDatabase();
                
                await db.collection('handler_errors').insertOne({
                    handler: handlerName,
                    operationType: change.operationType,
                    documentId: change.documentKey,
                    error: {
                        message: error.message,
                        stack: error.stack,
                        code: error.code
                    },
                    timestamp: new Date(),
                    resumeToken: change._id
                });
            }
            
            async enqueueForRetry(handler, change, error) {
                // 将失败的处理加入重试队列
                const db = this.getDatabase();
                
                await db.collection('retry_queue').insertOne({
                    handler: handler.name,
                    change: {
                        operationType: change.operationType,
                        documentKey: change.documentKey,
                        fullDocument: change.fullDocument,
                        updateDescription: change.updateDescription,
                        resumeToken: change._id
                    },
                    error: error.message,
                    attempts: 1,
                    nextRetry: new Date(Date.now() + 60000), // 1分钟后重试
                    createdAt: new Date()
                });
            }
        }
    `
};

5. Change Streams 实际应用场景 ​

5.1 实时推荐系统 ​

javascript
// 使用 Change Streams 构建实时推荐系统
class RealTimeRecommendationSystem {
    constructor(client) {
        this.client = client;
        this.userProfiles = new Map(); // 内存中的用户画像（生产环境用Redis）
        this.productAffinity = new Map(); // 产品关联度
        this.recommendationCache = new Map(); // 推荐缓存
    }
    
    async initialize() {
        // 初始化系统
        console.log('Initializing Real-Time Recommendation System');
        
        // 1. 监听用户行为
        await this.setupUserBehaviorStream();
        
        // 2. 监听产品更新
        await this.setupProductUpdateStream();
        
        // 3. 监听订单事件
        await this.setupOrderStream();
        
        // 4. 启动定期任务
        this.startPeriodicTasks();
        
        console.log('Recommendation System initialized');
    }
    
    async setupUserBehaviorStream() {
        // 监听用户行为集合
        const db = this.client.db('ecommerce');
        const behaviorStream = db.collection('user_behaviors').watch([
            {
                $match: {
                    operationType: { $in: ['insert', 'update'] },
                    // 只关注特定行为类型
                    $or: [
                        { 'fullDocument.type': 'view' },
                        { 'fullDocument.type': 'click' },
                        { 'fullDocument.type': 'search' },
                        { 'fullDocument.type': 'add_to_cart' }
                    ]
                }
            },
            {
                $project: {
                    userId: '$fullDocument.userId',
                    productId: '$fullDocument.productId',
                    behaviorType: '$fullDocument.type',
                    timestamp: '$fullDocument.timestamp',
                    metadata: '$fullDocument.metadata'
                }
            }
        ], {
            fullDocument: 'updateLookup'
        });
        
        behaviorStream.on('change', async (change) => {
            try {
                await this.processUserBehavior(change);
            } catch (error) {
                console.error('Error processing user behavior:', error);
            }
        });
        
        behaviorStream.on('error', (error) => {
            console.error('User behavior stream error:', error);
        });
        
        console.log('User behavior stream initialized');
    }
    
    async processUserBehavior(behavior) {
        const { userId, productId, behaviorType, timestamp, metadata } = behavior;
        
        if (!userId || !productId) {
            return;
        }
        
        // 更新用户画像
        await this.updateUserProfile(userId, {
            type: behaviorType,
            productId,
            timestamp,
            metadata
        });
        
        // 更新产品关联度
        if (behaviorType === 'view' || behaviorType === 'add_to_cart') {
            await this.updateProductAffinity(productId, userId, behaviorType);
        }
        
        // 如果用户查看了产品详情，立即生成推荐
        if (behaviorType === 'view' && metadata?.duration > 5000) {
            // 用户看了超过5秒，可能感兴趣
            const recommendations = await this.generateRealTimeRecommendations(
                userId, 
                productId
            );
            
            // 缓存推荐结果
            this.recommendationCache.set(`realtime:${userId}:${productId}`, {
                recommendations,
                generatedAt: new Date(),
                ttl: 300000 // 5分钟
            });
            
            // 可选：推送到前端
            await this.pushRecommendationsToUser(userId, productId, recommendations);
        }
    }
    
    async updateUserProfile(userId, behavior) {
        // 获取或创建用户画像
        let profile = this.userProfiles.get(userId);
        
        if (!profile) {
            profile = {
                userId,
                behaviors: [],
                interests: new Map(),
                lastUpdated: new Date()
            };
            this.userProfiles.set(userId, profile);
        }
        
        // 添加行为记录
        profile.behaviors.push({
            ...behavior,
            processedAt: new Date()
        });
        
        // 保持最近1000个行为
        if (profile.behaviors.length > 1000) {
            profile.behaviors = profile.behaviors.slice(-1000);
        }
        
        // 更新兴趣标签
        await this.updateUserInterests(profile, behavior);
        
        profile.lastUpdated = new Date();
    }
    
    async updateUserInterests(profile, behavior) {
        // 根据行为类型更新兴趣权重
        const weights = {
            'view': 1,
            'click': 2,
            'add_to_cart': 3,
            'purchase': 5,
            'search': 2
        };
        
        const weight = weights[behavior.type] || 1;
        
        // 获取产品标签
        const productTags = await this.getProductTags(behavior.productId);
        
        // 更新兴趣标签权重
        productTags.forEach(tag => {
            const currentWeight = profile.interests.get(tag) || 0;
            profile.interests.set(tag, currentWeight + weight);
        });
        
        // 衰减旧兴趣
        this.decayOldInterests(profile);
    }
    
    async getProductTags(productId) {
        // 从数据库获取产品标签
        const db = this.client.db('ecommerce');
        const product = await db.collection('products').findOne(
            { _id: productId },
            { projection: { tags: 1 } }
        );
        
        return product?.tags || [];
    }
    
    decayOldInterests(profile) {
        // 兴趣衰减：每天衰减10%
        const daysSinceUpdate = (new Date() - profile.lastUpdated) / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24);
        const decayFactor = Math.pow(0.9, daysSinceUpdate);
        
        for (const [tag, weight] of profile.interests.entries()) {
            profile.interests.set(tag, weight * decayFactor);
            
            // 移除权重过低的标签
            if (weight * decayFactor < 0.1) {
                profile.interests.delete(tag);
            }
        }
    }
    
    async updateProductAffinity(productId, userId, behaviorType) {
        // 更新产品关联度矩阵
        
        // 获取用户最近浏览的其他产品
        const profile = this.userProfiles.get(userId);
        if (!profile) return;
        
        // 查找用户最近的行为
        const recentBehaviors = profile.behaviors
            .filter(b => 
                b.productId !== productId && 
                b.timestamp > Date.now() - 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000 // 24小时内
            )
            .slice(-10); // 最近10个
        
        // 更新关联度
        for (const behavior of recentBehaviors) {
            const otherProductId = behavior.productId;
            
            // 生成关联键
            const key1 = `${productId}:${otherProductId}`;
            const key2 = `${otherProductId}:${productId}`;
            
            // 获取当前关联度
            const currentAffinity1 = this.productAffinity.get(key1) || 0;
            const currentAffinity2 = this.productAffinity.get(key2) || 0;
            
            // 计算增量（根据行为类型）
            const increment = this.calculateAffinityIncrement(behaviorType, behavior.type);
            
            // 更新关联度（双向）
            this.productAffinity.set(key1, currentAffinity1 + increment);
            this.productAffinity.set(key2, currentAffinity2 + increment);
        }
        
        // 定期清理低关联度条目
        if (Math.random() < 0.01) { // 1%概率清理
            this.cleanupLowAffinityProducts();
        }
    }
    
    calculateAffinityIncrement(currentBehavior, otherBehavior) {
        // 计算关联度增量
        const behaviorWeights = {
            'view': { 'view': 0.1, 'add_to_cart': 0.3, 'purchase': 0.5 },
            'add_to_cart': { 'view': 0.3, 'add_to_cart': 0.5, 'purchase': 1.0 },
            'purchase': { 'view': 0.5, 'add_to_cart': 1.0, 'purchase': 1.5 }
        };
        
        return behaviorWeights[currentBehavior]?.[otherBehavior] || 0.05;
    }
    
    cleanupLowAffinityProducts() {
        // 清理低关联度产品
        const threshold = 0.1;
        
        for (const [key, affinity] of this.productAffinity.entries()) {
            if (affinity < threshold) {
                this.productAffinity.delete(key);
            }
        }
    }
    
    async setupProductUpdateStream() {
        // 监听产品更新
        const db = this.client.db('ecommerce');
        const productStream = db.collection('products').watch([
            {
                $match: {
                    operationType: { $in: ['insert', 'update', 'replace'] }
                }
            }
        ], {
            fullDocument: 'updateLookup'
        });
        
        productStream.on('change', async (change) => {
            try {
                await this.processProductUpdate(change);
            } catch (error) {
                console.error('Error processing product update:', error);
            }
        });
        
        console.log('Product update stream initialized');
    }
    
    async processProductUpdate(change) {
        const product = change.fullDocument;
        
        if (!product) {
            return;
        }
        
        // 更新产品缓存
        await this.updateProductCache(product);
        
        // 如果产品库存状态变化，更新推荐
        if (change.operationType === 'update' && 
            change.updateDescription?.updatedFields?.stock) {
            
            const newStock = change.updateDescription.updatedFields.stock;
            
            if (newStock === 0) {
                // 产品缺货，从推荐中移除
                await this.removeOutOfStockProduct(product._id);
            } else if (newStock > 0) {
                // 产品补货，重新加入推荐
                await this.addRestockedProduct(product._id);
            }
        }
        
        // 如果产品价格变化，重新计算推荐
        if (change.updateDescription?.updatedFields?.price) {
            await this.recalculateAffectedRecommendations(product._id);
        }
    }
    
    async setupOrderStream() {
        // 监听订单事件
        const db = this.client.db('ecommerce');
        const orderStream = db.collection('orders').watch([
            {
                $match: {
                    operationType: 'insert',
                    'fullDocument.status': 'completed'
                }
            }
        ], {
            fullDocument: 'updateLookup'
        });
        
        orderStream.on('change', async (change) => {
            try {
                await this.processOrderCompletion(change.fullDocument);
            } catch (error) {
                console.error('Error processing order completion:', error);
            }
        });
        
        console.log('Order stream initialized');
    }
    
    async processOrderCompletion(order) {
        // 处理订单完成事件
        const userId = order.userId;
        const products = order.items.map(item => item.productId);
        
        // 更新用户购买历史
        await this.updateUserPurchaseHistory(userId, products);
        
        // 增强购买产品的关联度
        for (let i = 0; i < products.length; i++) {
            for (let j = i + 1; j < products.length; j++) {
                const key1 = `${products[i]}:${products[j]}`;
                const key2 = `${products[j]}:${products[i]}`;
                
                // 购买一起的产品关联度更高
                const current1 = this.productAffinity.get(key1) || 0;
                const current2 = this.productAffinity.get(key2) || 0;
                
                this.productAffinity.set(key1, current1 + 2.0);
                this.productAffinity.set(key2, current2 + 2.0);
            }
        }
        
        // 为用户生成新的推荐（交叉销售）
        const crossSellRecommendations = await this.generateCrossSellRecommendations(
            userId, 
            products
        );
        
        // 缓存交叉销售推荐
        this.recommendationCache.set(`crosssell:${userId}:${order._id}`, {
            recommendations: crossSellRecommendations,
            generatedAt: new Date(),
            ttl: 86400000 // 24小时
        });
    }
    
    async updateUserPurchaseHistory(userId, productIds) {
        const profile = this.userProfiles.get(userId);
        if (!profile) return;
        
        // 添加购买记录
        productIds.forEach(productId => {
            profile.behaviors.push({
                type: 'purchase',
                productId,
                timestamp: new Date(),
                processedAt: new Date()
            });
        });
        
        // 更新兴趣标签（购买权重更高）
        for (const productId of productIds) {
            const productTags = await this.getProductTags(productId);
            
            productTags.forEach(tag => {
                const currentWeight = profile.interests.get(tag) || 0;
                profile.interests.set(tag, currentWeight + 5); // 购买权重更高
            });
        }
    }
    
    async generateRealTimeRecommendations(userId, currentProductId) {
        // 实时推荐生成算法
        
        const startTime = Date.now();
        const profile = this.userProfiles.get(userId);
        
        if (!profile) {
            return this.getPopularProducts(10); // 返回热门产品
        }
        
        // 1. 基于产品关联度
        const affinityRecommendations = await this.getAffinityBasedRecommendations(
            currentProductId, 
            20
        );
        
        // 2. 基于用户兴趣
        const interestRecommendations = await this.getInterestBasedRecommendations(
            profile, 
            20
        );
        
        // 3. 基于协同过滤（简化）
        const cfRecommendations = await this.getCollaborativeFilteringRecommendations(
            userId, 
            20
        );
        
        // 合并和排序推荐
        const allRecommendations = [
            ...affinityRecommendations,
            ...interestRecommendations,
            ...cfRecommendations
        ];
        
        // 去重和评分
        const scoredProducts = new Map();
        
        allRecommendations.forEach((rec, index) => {
            const productId = rec.productId;
            const currentScore = scoredProducts.get(productId) || 0;
            
            // 根据来源和位置计算分数
            let score = currentScore;
            
            if (index < 10) score += 3; // 前10个结果加分
            else if (index < 20) score += 2;
            else score += 1;
            
            // 来源加分
            if (rec.source === 'affinity') score += 2;
            if (rec.source === 'interest') score += 1.5;
            if (rec.source === 'collaborative') score += 1;
            
            scoredProducts.set(productId, {
                productId,
                score,
                details: rec
            });
        });
        
        // 转换为数组并排序
        const sortedRecommendations = Array.from(scoredProducts.values())
            .sort((a, b) => b.score - a.score)
            .slice(0, 10); // 取前10个
        
        console.log(`Generated real-time recommendations for user ${userId} in ${Date.now() - startTime}ms`);
        
        return sortedRecommendations;
    }
    
    async getAffinityBasedRecommendations(productId, limit) {
        const recommendations = [];
        
        // 查找与当前产品关联度高的产品
        for (const [key, affinity] of this.productAffinity.entries()) {
            if (key.startsWith(`${productId}:`)) {
                const relatedProductId = key.split(':')[1];
                recommendations.push({
                    productId: relatedProductId,
                    score: affinity,
                    source: 'affinity'
                });
            }
        }
        
        // 按关联度排序
        recommendations.sort((a, b) => b.score - a.score);
        
        return recommendations.slice(0, limit);
    }
    
    async getInterestBasedRecommendations(profile, limit) {
        // 基于用户兴趣的推荐
        const recommendations = [];
        
        // 获取用户最感兴趣的前5个标签
        const topInterests = Array.from(profile.interests.entries())
            .sort((a, b) => b[1] - a[1])
            .slice(0, 5)
            .map(([tag]) => tag);
        
        if (topInterests.length === 0) {
            return recommendations;
        }
        
        // 查询具有这些标签的产品
        const db = this.client.db('ecommerce');
        const products = await db.collection('products').find(
            { 
                tags: { $in: topInterests },
                stock: { $gt: 0 } // 只推荐有库存的
            },
            {
                projection: { _id: 1, tags: 1 },
                limit: limit * 2
            }
        ).toArray();
        
        // 计算匹配分数
        products.forEach(product => {
            let score = 0;
            
            // 计算标签匹配度
            product.tags?.forEach(tag => {
                const tagWeight = profile.interests.get(tag) || 0;
                score += tagWeight;
            });
            
            if (score > 0) {
                recommendations.push({
                    productId: product._id,
                    score,
                    source: 'interest',
                    matchingTags: product.tags?.filter(t => topInterests.includes(t))
                });
            }
        });
        
        recommendations.sort((a, b) => b.score - a.score);
        return recommendations.slice(0, limit);
    }
    
    async getCollaborativeFilteringRecommendations(userId, limit) {
        // 简化的协同过滤
        // 实际生产环境需要更复杂的算法
        
        // 找到相似用户
        const similarUsers = await this.findSimilarUsers(userId, 5);
        
        if (similarUsers.length === 0) {
            return [];
        }
        
        // 获取这些用户喜欢但当前用户没看过的产品
        const db = this.client.db('ecommerce');
        
        // 获取当前用户的行为
        const currentUserBehaviors = this.userProfiles.get(userId)?.behaviors || [];
        const currentUserProductIds = new Set(
            currentUserBehaviors.map(b => b.productId)
        );
        
        // 获取相似用户的行为
        const recommendations = [];
        const productScores = new Map();
        
        for (const similarUser of similarUsers) {
            const similarProfile = this.userProfiles.get(similarUser.userId);
            if (!similarProfile) continue;
            
            // 相似用户的高权重行为
            const highValueBehaviors = similarProfile.behaviors.filter(b => 
                ['add_to_cart', 'purchase'].includes(b.type)
            );
            
            highValueBehaviors.forEach(behavior => {
                const productId = behavior.productId;
                
                // 跳过当前用户已经接触过的产品
                if (currentUserProductIds.has(productId)) {
                    return;
                }
                
                // 计算分数
                const currentScore = productScores.get(productId) || 0;
                const similarityWeight = similarUser.similarity;
                const behaviorWeight = behavior.type === 'purchase' ? 2 : 1;
                
                productScores.set(productId, currentScore + similarityWeight * behaviorWeight);
            });
        }
        
        // 转换为推荐格式
        for (const [productId, score] of productScores.entries()) {
            if (score > 0) {
                recommendations.push({
                    productId,
                    score,
                    source: 'collaborative'
                });
            }
        }
        
        recommendations.sort((a, b) => b.score - a.score);
        return recommendations.slice(0, limit);
    }
    
    async findSimilarUsers(userId, limit) {
        // 查找相似用户（基于兴趣标签）
        const currentProfile = this.userProfiles.get(userId);
        
        if (!currentProfile || currentProfile.interests.size === 0) {
            return [];
        }
        
        const similarUsers = [];
        const currentInterests = Array.from(currentProfile.interests.entries());
        
        // 与其他用户比较
        for (const [otherUserId, otherProfile] of this.userProfiles.entries()) {
            if (otherUserId === userId) continue;
            
            let similarity = 0;
            const otherInterests = Array.from(otherProfile.interests.entries());
            
            // 计算余弦相似度（简化）
            for (const [tag, weight] of currentInterests) {
                const otherWeight = otherProfile.interests.get(tag) || 0;
                similarity += weight * otherWeight;
            }
            
            if (similarity > 0) {
                similarUsers.push({
                    userId: otherUserId,
                    similarity,
                    interests: otherInterests.length
                });
            }
        }
        
        // 按相似度排序
        similarUsers.sort((a, b) => b.similarity - a.similarity);
        return similarUsers.slice(0, limit);
    }
    
    async getPopularProducts(limit) {
        // 获取热门产品
        const db = this.client.db('ecommerce');
        
        // 可以从专门的统计集合获取
        const popularProducts = await db.collection('product_stats')
            .find({}, {
                sort: { viewCount: -1 },
                limit
            })
            .toArray();
        
        return popularProducts.map(p => ({
            productId: p.productId,
            score: p.viewCount || 0,
            source: 'popular'
        }));
    }

    async generateCrossSellRecommendations(userId, purchasedProducts) {
        // 生成交叉销售推荐
        const recommendations = [];
        const productScores = new Map();
        
        // 对每个购买的产品，查找关联产品
        for (const purchasedProductId of purchasedProducts) {
            const related = await this.getAffinityBasedRecommendations(purchasedProductId, 10);
            
            related.forEach(rec => {
                // 跳过已购买的产品
                if (purchasedProducts.includes(rec.productId)) {
                    return;
                }
                
                const currentScore = productScores.get(rec.productId) || 0;
                productScores.set(rec.productId, currentScore + rec.score);
            });
        }
        
        // 转换为推荐格式
        for (const [productId, score] of productScores.entries()) {
            recommendations.push({
                productId,
                score,
                source: 'cross_sell'
            });
        }
        
        recommendations.sort((a, b) => b.score - a.score);
        return recommendations.slice(0, 5); // 返回前5个交叉销售推荐
    }

    cleanupOldCache() {
        const now = Date.now();
        let cleaned = 0;
        
        for (const [key, value] of this.recommendationCache.entries()) {
            if (value.generatedAt.getTime() + value.ttl < now) {
                this.recommendationCache.delete(key);
                cleaned++;
            }
        }
        
        if (cleaned > 0) {
            console.log(`Cleaned ${cleaned} old cache entries`);
        }
    }

    // API方法：获取用户推荐
    async getRecommendationsForUser(userId, context = {}) {
        const { currentProductId, limit = 10 } = context;
        
        // 检查缓存
        if (currentProductId) {
            const cacheKey = `realtime:${userId}:${currentProductId}`;
            const cached = this.recommendationCache.get(cacheKey);
            
            if (cached && cached.generatedAt.getTime() + cached.ttl > Date.now()) {
                console.log(`Returning cached recommendations for user ${userId}`);
                return cached.recommendations.slice(0, limit);
            }
        }
        
        // 生成新推荐
        let recommendations;
        
        if (currentProductId) {
            recommendations = await this.generateRealTimeRecommendations(userId, currentProductId);
        } else {
            // 通用推荐
            recommendations = await this.getGeneralRecommendations(userId);
        }
        
        return recommendations.slice(0, limit);
    }
    
    async getGeneralRecommendations(userId) {
        // 获取通用推荐（非上下文相关）
        const profile = this.userProfiles.get(userId);
        
        if (!profile) {
            return this.getPopularProducts(10);
        }
        
        // 组合多种推荐策略
        const interestRecs = await this.getInterestBasedRecommendations(profile, 15);
        const cfRecs = await this.getCollaborativeFilteringRecommendations(userId, 10);
        const popularRecs = await this.getPopularProducts(5);
        
        // 合并和去重
        const allRecs = [...interestRecs, ...cfRecs, ...popularRecs];
        const uniqueRecs = new Map();
        
        allRecs.forEach(rec => {
            if (!uniqueRecs.has(rec.productId) || uniqueRecs.get(rec.productId).score < rec.score) {
                uniqueRecs.set(rec.productId, rec);
            }
        });
        
        return Array.from(uniqueRecs.values())
            .sort((a, b) => b.score - a.score)
            .slice(0, 10);
    }
}

// 推荐系统WebSocket集成
class RecommendationWebSocketServer {
    constructor(recommendationSystem, wss) {
        this.recommendationSystem = recommendationSystem;
        this.wss = wss;
        this.userConnections = new Map(); // userId -> WebSocket连接
        
        this.setupWebSocketHandlers();
    }
    
    setupWebSocketHandlers() {
        this.wss.on('connection', (ws, request) => {
            console.log('New WebSocket connection');
            
            // 从请求中提取用户ID（实际中应从认证获取）
            const userId = this.extractUserId(request);
            
            if (!userId) {
                ws.close(1008, 'User ID required');
                return;
            }
            
            // 存储连接
            this.userConnections.set(userId, ws);
            
            // 发送初始推荐
            this.sendInitialRecommendations(userId, ws);
            
            // 设置消息处理器
            ws.on('message', async (message) => {
                await this.handleWebSocketMessage(userId, message);
            });
            
            // 清理断开连接
            ws.on('close', () => {
                this.userConnections.delete(userId);
                console.log(`WebSocket disconnected for user ${userId}`);
            });
            
            ws.on('error', (error) => {
                console.error(`WebSocket error for user ${userId}:`, error);
                this.userConnections.delete(userId);
            });
        });
    }
    
    extractUserId(request) {
        // 从请求中提取用户ID
        // 实际实现可能从cookie、token或查询参数获取
        const url = new URL(request.url, `http://${request.headers.host}`);
        return url.searchParams.get('userId');
    }
    
    async sendInitialRecommendations(userId, ws) {
        try {
            const recommendations = await this.recommendationSystem.getGeneralRecommendations(userId);
            
            ws.send(JSON.stringify({
                type: 'initial_recommendations',
                data: recommendations,
                timestamp: new Date().toISOString()
            }));
        } catch (error) {
            console.error(`Failed to send initial recommendations to user ${userId}:`, error);
        }
    }
    
    async handleWebSocketMessage(userId, message) {
        try {
            const data = JSON.parse(message);
            
            switch (data.type) {
                case 'product_view':
                    // 用户查看产品，发送实时推荐
                    await this.handleProductView(userId, data.productId);
                    break;
                    
                case 'get_recommendations':
                    // 请求获取推荐
                    await this.handleGetRecommendations(userId, data.context);
                    break;
                    
                case 'feedback':
                    // 用户对推荐的反馈
                    await this.handleRecommendationFeedback(userId, data.feedback);
                    break;
                    
                default:
                    console.warn(`Unknown message type from user ${userId}:`, data.type);
            }
        } catch (error) {
            console.error(`Error handling WebSocket message from user ${userId}:`, error);
        }
    }
    
    async handleProductView(userId, productId) {
        const ws = this.userConnections.get(userId);
        if (!ws) return;
        
        // 获取实时推荐
        const recommendations = await this.recommendationSystem.getRecommendationsForUser(userId, {
            currentProductId: productId,
            limit: 5
        });
        
        // 发送推荐
        ws.send(JSON.stringify({
            type: 'realtime_recommendations',
            data: {
                forProduct: productId,
                recommendations
            },
            timestamp: new Date().toISOString()
        }));
        
        // 记录事件
        await this.recordRecommendationEvent(userId, 'view', productId, recommendations);
    }
    
    async handleGetRecommendations(userId, context) {
        const ws = this.userConnections.get(userId);
        if (!ws) return;
        
        const recommendations = await this.recommendationSystem.getRecommendationsForUser(
            userId, 
            context
        );
        
        ws.send(JSON.stringify({
            type: 'recommendations',
            data: recommendations,
            context,
            timestamp: new Date().toISOString()
        }));
    }
    
    async handleRecommendationFeedback(userId, feedback) {
        // 处理用户对推荐的反馈
        console.log(`Feedback from user ${userId}:`, feedback);
        
        // 记录反馈
        const db = this.recommendationSystem.client.db('ecommerce');
        await db.collection('recommendation_feedback').insertOne({
            userId,
            ...feedback,
            receivedAt: new Date()
        });
        
        // 可以根据反馈调整推荐策略
        // 例如：如果用户经常忽略某种推荐，降低其权重
    }
    
    async recordRecommendationEvent(userId, eventType, context, recommendations) {
        // 记录推荐事件
        const db = this.recommendationSystem.client.db('ecommerce');
        
        await db.collection('recommendation_delivery_logs').insertOne({
            userId,
            eventType,
            context,
            recommendations: recommendations.map(r => r.productId),
            deliveredAt: new Date(),
            via: 'websocket'
        });
    }
    
    // 主动推送推荐（例如当库存变化时）
    async pushProductUpdate(productId, updateType) {
        // 找到可能对该产品感兴趣的用户
        const interestedUsers = this.findUsersInterestedInProduct(productId);
        
        // 向这些用户推送更新
        for (const userId of interestedUsers) {
            await this.pushUpdateToUser(userId, productId, updateType);
        }
    }
    
    findUsersInterestedInProduct(productId) {
        // 查找对产品感兴趣的用户
        // 简化实现：返回所有连接的用户
        return Array.from(this.userConnections.keys());
    }
    
    async pushUpdateToUser(userId, productId, updateType) {
        const ws = this.userConnections.get(userId);
        if (!ws) return;
        
        let message;
        
        switch (updateType) {
            case 'back_in_stock':
                message = {
                    type: 'product_back_in_stock',
                    data: { productId },
                    timestamp: new Date().toISOString()
                };
                break;
                
            case 'price_drop':
                message = {
                    type: 'price_drop',
                    data: { productId },
                    timestamp: new Date().toISOString()
                };
                break;
                
            case 'new_review':
                message = {
                    type: 'new_review',
                    data: { productId },
                    timestamp: new Date().toISOString()
                };
                break;
        }
        
        if (message) {
            ws.send(JSON.stringify(message));
        }
    }
}

5.2 微服务数据同步 ​

javascript
// 使用 Change Streams 实现微服务数据同步
class MicroserviceDataSynchronizer {
    constructor(sourceClient, targetClients) {
        this.sourceClient = sourceClient; // 源 MongoDB 集群
        this.targetClients = targetClients; // 目标服务连接
        
        // 同步状态跟踪
        this.syncState = new Map(); // serviceName -> { lastResumeToken, lastSyncTime }
        this.errorCounters = new Map(); // serviceName -> errorCount
        
        // 同步配置
        this.syncConfigs = new Map(); // collectionName -> syncConfig
    }
    
    // 定义同步配置
    defineSync(config) {
        const {
            sourceDatabase,
            sourceCollection,
            targetService,
            targetEndpoint,
            transformFunction,
            filterCriteria,
            batchSize = 100,
            retryAttempts = 3,
            syncDelay = 0,
            conflictResolution = 'source_wins'
        } = config;
        
        const syncKey = `${sourceDatabase}.${sourceCollection}`;
        
        this.syncConfigs.set(syncKey, {
            sourceDatabase,
            sourceCollection,
            targetService,
            targetEndpoint,
            transformFunction: transformFunction || this.defaultTransform,
            filterCriteria: filterCriteria || {},
            batchSize,
            retryAttempts,
            syncDelay,
            conflictResolution,
            // 状态跟踪
            stats: {
                syncedCount: 0,
                errorCount: 0,
                lastSuccess: null,
                lastError: null
            }
        });
        
        console.log(`Defined sync: ${syncKey} -> ${targetService}`);
    }
    
    // 默认转换函数
    defaultTransform(change) {
        // 将 Change Stream 事件转换为目标服务的格式
        return {
            eventId: change._id._data,
            operation: change.operationType,
            documentId: change.documentKey._id,
            timestamp: change.wallTime || new Date(),
            data: change.fullDocument || {},
            changes: change.updateDescription,
            metadata: {
                source: 'mongodb_change_stream',
                database: change.ns.db,
                collection: change.ns.coll
            }
        };
    }
    
    // 启动所有同步
    async startAllSyncs() {
        for (const [syncKey, config] of this.syncConfigs.entries()) {
            await this.startSync(syncKey, config);
        }
        
        console.log(`Started ${this.syncConfigs.size} syncs`);
        
        // 启动监控
        this.startMonitoring();
    }
    
    // 启动单个同步
    async startSync(syncKey, config) {
        const { sourceDatabase, sourceCollection, filterCriteria } = config;
        
        try {
            const db = this.sourceClient.db(sourceDatabase);
            const collection = db.collection(sourceCollection);
            
            // 加载上次同步状态
            const lastState = await this.loadSyncState(syncKey);
            
            // 构建聚合管道
            const pipeline = [];
            
            // 添加过滤条件
            if (Object.keys(filterCriteria).length > 0) {
                pipeline.push({
                    $match: filterCriteria
                });
            }
            
            // 打开 Change Stream
            const options = {
                fullDocument: 'updateLookup',
                batchSize: config.batchSize,
                maxAwaitTimeMS: 5000
            };
            
            // 设置恢复点
            if (lastState?.resumeToken) {
                options.startAfter = lastState.resumeToken;
                console.log(`Resuming sync ${syncKey} from resume token`);
            } else if (lastState?.operationTime) {
                options.startAtOperationTime = lastState.operationTime;
                console.log(`Starting sync ${syncKey} from operation time`);
            }
            
            const changeStream = collection.watch(pipeline, options);
            
            // 处理事件
            this.processChangeStream(changeStream, syncKey, config);
            
            console.log(`Started sync for ${syncKey}`);
            
        } catch (error) {
            console.error(`Failed to start sync for ${syncKey}:`, error);
            
            // 记录错误
            config.stats.lastError = {
                error: error.message,
                timestamp: new Date()
            };
            config.stats.errorCount++;
            
            // 重试逻辑
            await this.retrySyncStart(syncKey, config, error);
        }
    }
    
    async processChangeStream(changeStream, syncKey, config) {
        const { targetService, targetEndpoint, syncDelay } = config;
        
        changeStream.on('change', async (change) => {
            try {
                // 应用同步延迟
                if (syncDelay > 0) {
                    await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, syncDelay));
                }
                
                // 处理事件
                await this.processChangeEvent(change, syncKey, config);
                
                // 更新同步状态
                await this.updateSyncState(syncKey, {
                    resumeToken: change._id,
                    operationTime: change.clusterTime,
                    lastProcessed: new Date()
                });
                
                // 更新统计
                config.stats.syncedCount++;
                config.stats.lastSuccess = new Date();
                
            } catch (error) {
                console.error(`Error processing change for ${syncKey}:`, error);
                
                // 更新错误统计
                config.stats.errorCount++;
                config.stats.lastError = {
                    error: error.message,
                    timestamp: new Date(),
                    changeId: change._id._data
                };
                
                // 错误处理
                await this.handleSyncError(error, change, syncKey, config);
            }
        });
        
        changeStream.on('error', async (error) => {
            console.error(`Change stream error for ${syncKey}:`, error);
            
            // 尝试重新连接
            setTimeout(() => {
                console.log(`Attempting to restart sync for ${syncKey}`);
                this.startSync(syncKey, config);
            }, 5000);
        });
        
        changeStream.on('close', () => {
            console.log(`Change stream closed for ${syncKey}`);
        });
    }
    
    async processChangeEvent(change, syncKey, config) {
        const { targetService, targetEndpoint, transformFunction, conflictResolution } = config;
        
        // 转换事件
        const payload = transformFunction(change);
        
        // 获取目标客户端
        const targetClient = this.targetClients.get(targetService);
        if (!targetClient) {
            throw new Error(`Target client not found for service: ${targetService}`);
        }
        
        // 根据操作类型调用不同的端点
        let endpoint = targetEndpoint;
        let method = 'POST';
        
        switch (change.operationType) {
            case 'insert':
            case 'replace':
                method = 'POST';
                break;
                
            case 'update':
                method = 'PATCH';
                // 可以附加文档ID到端点
                endpoint = `${targetEndpoint}/${change.documentKey._id}`;
                break;
                
            case 'delete':
                method = 'DELETE';
                endpoint = `${targetEndpoint}/${change.documentKey._id}`;
                break;
        }
        
        // 发送到目标服务
        const response = await targetClient.request({
            method,
            url: endpoint,
            data: payload,
            headers: {
                'Content-Type': 'application/json',
                'X-Change-Event-ID': change._id._data,
                'X-Change-Operation': change.operationType,
                'X-Sync-Source': syncKey
            }
        });
        
        // 检查响应
        if (response.status >= 400) {
            throw new Error(`Target service returned error: ${response.status} ${response.statusText}`);
        }
        
        console.log(`Synced ${change.operationType} to ${targetService}: ${change.documentKey._id}`);
        
        return response;
    }
    
    async loadSyncState(syncKey) {
        // 从数据库加载同步状态
        try {
            const db = this.sourceClient.db('_sync_metadata');
            const state = await db.collection('sync_states').findOne({ syncKey });
            return state;
        } catch (error) {
            console.error(`Failed to load sync state for ${syncKey}:`, error);
            return null;
        }
    }
    
    async updateSyncState(syncKey, stateUpdate) {
        // 更新同步状态到数据库
        try {
            const db = this.sourceClient.db('_sync_metadata');
            
            await db.collection('sync_states').updateOne(
                { syncKey },
                {
                    $set: {
                        ...stateUpdate,
                        lastUpdated: new Date()
                    },
                    $setOnInsert: {
                        syncKey,
                        createdAt: new Date()
                    }
                },
                { upsert: true }
            );
        } catch (error) {
            console.error(`Failed to update sync state for ${syncKey}:`, error);
        }
    }
    
    async handleSyncError(error, change, syncKey, config) {
        const { retryAttempts } = config;
        
        // 获取当前重试计数
        const errorKey = `${syncKey}:${change._id._data}`;
        const currentRetries = this.errorCounters.get(errorKey) || 0;
        
        if (currentRetries < retryAttempts) {
            // 重试
            console.log(`Retrying sync for ${syncKey}, attempt ${currentRetries + 1}/${retryAttempts}`);
            
            this.errorCounters.set(errorKey, currentRetries + 1);
            
            // 指数退避
            const delay = Math.pow(2, currentRetries) * 1000;
            await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, delay));
            
            // 重新处理
            await this.processChangeEvent(change, syncKey, config);
            
            // 成功则清除错误计数
            this.errorCounters.delete(errorKey);
            
        } else {
            // 超过重试次数，记录失败
            console.error(`Failed to sync after ${retryAttempts} attempts: ${syncKey}`);
            
            // 记录到死信队列
            await this.sendToDeadLetterQueue(change, syncKey, config, error);
            
            // 清除错误计数
            this.errorCounters.delete(errorKey);
            
            // 可选：发送警报
            await this.sendSyncFailureAlert(syncKey, change, error);
        }
    }
    
    async sendToDeadLetterQueue(change, syncKey, config, error) {
        // 发送到死信队列供后续处理
        const db = this.sourceClient.db('_sync_metadata');
        
        await db.collection('sync_dead_letters').insertOne({
            syncKey,
            changeEvent: {
                id: change._id,
                operationType: change.operationType,
                documentKey: change.documentKey,
                clusterTime: change.clusterTime
            },
            config: {
                targetService: config.targetService,
                targetEndpoint: config.targetEndpoint
            },
            error: {
                message: error.message,
                stack: error.stack,
                code: error.code
            },
            attempts: config.retryAttempts,
            failedAt: new Date()
        });
        
        console.log(`Added failed sync to dead letter queue: ${syncKey}`);
    }
    
    async sendSyncFailureAlert(syncKey, change, error) {
        // 发送同步失败警报
        // 实际实现可能使用邮件、Slack等
        console.error(`SYNC FAILURE ALERT: ${syncKey} failed to sync ${change.operationType} on ${change.documentKey._id}`);
    }
    
    async retrySyncStart(syncKey, config, error) {
        // 同步启动失败的重试逻辑
        const maxRetries = 3;
        let retryCount = 0;
        
        while (retryCount < maxRetries) {
            retryCount++;
            
            console.log(`Retrying sync start for ${syncKey}, attempt ${retryCount}/${maxRetries}`);
            
            try {
                await new Promise(resolve => 
                    setTimeout(resolve, Math.pow(2, retryCount) * 1000)
                );
                
                await this.startSync(syncKey, config);
                return; // 成功
                
            } catch (retryError) {
                console.error(`Sync start retry ${retryCount} failed for ${syncKey}:`, retryError);
                
                if (retryCount === maxRetries) {
                    // 最终失败
                    console.error(`Failed to start sync for ${syncKey} after ${maxRetries} attempts`);
                    
                    // 发送警报
                    await this.sendSyncStartFailureAlert(syncKey, error);
                }
            }
        }
    }
    
    async sendSyncStartFailureAlert(syncKey, error) {
        // 发送同步启动失败警报
        console.error(`SYNC START FAILURE: ${syncKey} failed to start: ${error.message}`);
    }
    
    // 监控
    startMonitoring() {
        // 定期报告同步状态
        setInterval(() => {
            this.reportSyncStatus();
        }, 60 * 1000); // 每分钟
        
        // 定期清理旧状态
        setInterval(() => {
            this.cleanupOldData();
        }, 60 * 60 * 1000); // 每小时
    }
    
    reportSyncStatus() {
        const report = {
            timestamp: new Date(),
            totalSyncs: this.syncConfigs.size,
            syncStatuses: []
        };
        
        for (const [syncKey, config] of this.syncConfigs.entries()) {
            report.syncStatuses.push({
                syncKey,
                targetService: config.targetService,
                stats: config.stats,
                lastUpdated: config.stats.lastSuccess
            });
        }
        
        console.log('Sync Status Report:', JSON.stringify(report, null, 2));
        
        // 可以保存到数据库或发送到监控系统
        this.saveStatusReport(report);
    }
    
    async saveStatusReport(report) {
        const db = this.sourceClient.db('_sync_metadata');
        await db.collection('sync_status_reports').insertOne(report);
    }
    
    async cleanupOldData() {
        // 清理旧数据
        const db = this.sourceClient.db('_sync_metadata');
        const oneWeekAgo = new Date(Date.now() - 7 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000);
        
        // 清理旧的状态报告
        await db.collection('sync_status_reports').deleteMany({
            timestamp: { $lt: oneWeekAgo }
        });
        
        // 清理旧的死信队列条目
        await db.collection('sync_dead_letters').deleteMany({
            failedAt: { $lt: oneWeekAgo }
        });
        
        console.log('Cleaned up old sync metadata');
    }
    
    // 管理API
    async pauseSync(syncKey) {
        // 暂停同步
        // 需要实现暂停逻辑
        console.log(`Paused sync: ${syncKey}`);
    }
    
    async resumeSync(syncKey) {
        // 恢复同步
        console.log(`Resumed sync: ${syncKey}`);
    }
    
    async resetSync(syncKey) {
        // 重置同步状态
        const db = this.sourceClient.db('_sync_metadata');
        
        await db.collection('sync_states').deleteOne({ syncKey });
        
        console.log(`Reset sync state for ${syncKey}`);
    }
    
    async getSyncStatus(syncKey) {
        // 获取同步状态
        const config = this.syncConfigs.get(syncKey);
        if (!config) {
            throw new Error(`Sync not found: ${syncKey}`);
        }
        
        const state = await this.loadSyncState(syncKey);
        
        return {
            syncKey,
            config: {
                source: `${config.sourceDatabase}.${config.sourceCollection}`,
                target: `${config.targetService}${config.targetEndpoint}`
            },
            state,
            stats: config.stats,
            isActive: true // 需要跟踪活动状态
        };
    }
    
    async replaySync(syncKey, startTime, endTime) {
        // 重新同步特定时间范围的数据
        console.log(`Replaying sync ${syncKey} from ${startTime} to ${endTime}`);
        
        const config = this.syncConfigs.get(syncKey);
        if (!config) {
            throw new Error(`Sync not found: ${syncKey}`);
        }
        
        const { sourceDatabase, sourceCollection } = config;
        const db = this.sourceClient.db(sourceDatabase);
        const collection = db.collection(sourceCollection);
        
        // 查询该时间范围内的所有文档
        const cursor = collection.find({
            $or: [
                { createdAt: { $gte: startTime, $lte: endTime } },
                { updatedAt: { $gte: startTime, $lte: endTime } }
            ]
        });
        
        let replayedCount = 0;
        
        while (await cursor.hasNext()) {
            const doc = await cursor.next();
            
            // 创建模拟的 change 事件
            const changeEvent = {
                _id: { _data: `replay-${Date.now()}-${replayedCount}` },
                operationType: 'insert', // 或根据文档状态判断
                fullDocument: doc,
                documentKey: { _id: doc._id },
                ns: { db: sourceDatabase, coll: sourceCollection },
                wallTime: doc.updatedAt || doc.createdAt || new Date()
            };
            
            // 处理事件
            await this.processChangeEvent(changeEvent, syncKey, config);
            
            replayedCount++;
            
            // 进度报告
            if (replayedCount % 100 === 0) {
                console.log(`Replayed ${replayedCount} documents for ${syncKey}`);
            }
        }
        
        console.log(`Replay completed for ${syncKey}: ${replayedCount} documents`);
        
        return { replayedCount };
    }
}

// 目标服务客户端包装器
class TargetServiceClient {
    constructor(baseURL, options = {}) {
        this.baseURL = baseURL;
        this.options = {
            timeout: options.timeout || 30000,
            maxRetries: options.maxRetries || 3,
            retryDelay: options.retryDelay || 1000,
            ...options
        };
        
        // 请求队列
        this.requestQueue = [];
        this.processing = false;
        this.concurrency = options.concurrency || 5;
        
        // 统计
        this.stats = {
            totalRequests: 0,
            successful: 0,
            failed: 0,
            lastRequest: null
        };
    }
    
    async request(requestConfig) {
        const { method, url, data, headers } = requestConfig;
        const fullURL = `${this.baseURL}${url}`;
        
        this.stats.totalRequests++;
        this.stats.lastRequest = new Date();
        
        let lastError;
        
        // 重试逻辑
        for (let attempt = 0; attempt <= this.options.maxRetries; attempt++) {
            try {
                // 实际HTTP请求
                // 这里使用简化的fetch示例
                const response = await this.makeHttpRequest(fullURL, {
                    method,
                    headers: {
                        'Content-Type': 'application/json',
                        ...headers
                    },
                    body: JSON.stringify(data),
                    timeout: this.options.timeout
                });
                
                this.stats.successful++;
                return response;
                
            } catch (error) {
                lastError = error;
                
                if (attempt < this.options.maxRetries) {
                    // 指数退避
                    const delay = this.options.retryDelay * Math.pow(2, attempt);
                    console.warn(`Request failed, retrying in ${delay}ms (attempt ${attempt + 1}/${this.options.maxRetries})`);
                    
                    await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, delay));
                }
            }
        }
        
        // 所有重试都失败
        this.stats.failed++;
        throw lastError;
    }
    
    async makeHttpRequest(url, options) {
        // 实际HTTP请求实现
        // 可以使用fetch、axios、got等
        // 这里是简化示例
        
        return {
            status: 200,
            statusText: 'OK',
            data: { success: true }
        };
    }
    
    // 批量处理
    async batchRequest(requests) {
        const results = [];
        
        // 控制并发
        const batches = [];
        for (let i = 0; i < requests.length; i += this.concurrency) {
            batches.push(requests.slice(i, i + this.concurrency));
        }
        
        for (const batch of batches) {
            const batchResults = await Promise.allSettled(
                batch.map(req => this.request(req))
            );
            
            results.push(...batchResults);
        }
        
        return results;
    }
    
    getStats() {
        return {
            ...this.stats,
            successRate: this.stats.totalRequests > 0 
                ? (this.stats.successful / this.stats.totalRequests * 100).toFixed(2) + '%'
                : '0%'
        };
    }
}
