javascript
// 物联网设备数据处理系统
class IoTDataProcessor {
    constructor(client) {
        this.client = client;
        this.deviceStates = new Map(); // deviceId -> last state
        this.dataStreams = new Map(); // deviceType -> Change Stream
        this.alerts = new Map(); // alertId -> alert info
        
        // 处理窗口
        this.processingWindow = {
            duration: 60000, // 1分钟窗口
            overlap: 10000 // 10秒重叠
        };
    }
    
    async initialize() {
        console.log('Initializing IoT Data Processor');
        
        // 1. 设置设备数据流
        await this.setupDeviceDataStreams();
        
        // 2. 设置警报流
        await this.setupAlertStream();
        
        // 3. 设置设备状态流
        await this.setupDeviceStatusStream();
        
        // 4. 启动聚合任务
        this.startAggregationTasks();
        
        // 5. 启动清理任务
        this.startCleanupTasks();
        
        console.log('IoT Data Processor initialized');
    }
    
    async setupDeviceDataStreams() {
        const db = this.client.db('iot');
        
        // 监听所有设备数据集合
        const collections = await db.listCollections().toArray();
        
        for (const collInfo of collections) {
            if (collInfo.name.startsWith('device_data_')) {
                await this.setupDeviceDataStream(collInfo.name);
            }
        }
        
        // 监听新集合创建
        await this.watchForNewCollections();
    }
    
    async setupDeviceDataStream(collectionName) {
        const db = this.client.db('iot');
        const collection = db.collection(collectionName);
        
        // 提取设备类型
        const deviceType = collectionName.replace('device_data_', '');
        
        const pipeline = [
            {
                $match: {
                    operationType: 'insert'
                }
            },
            {
                $addFields: {
                    // 添加处理时间戳
                    processedAt: new Date(),
                    // 提取设备ID
                    deviceId: '$fullDocument.deviceId',
                    // 解析时间戳
                    timestamp: {
                        $cond: {
                            if: { $gte: ['$fullDocument.timestamp', 0] },
                            then: { $toDate: '$fullDocument.timestamp' },
                            else: '$fullDocument.timestamp'
                        }
                    },
                    // 数值数据
                    values: '$fullDocument.values'
                }
            },
            {
                $match: {
                    // 过滤无效数据
                    deviceId: { $exists: true, $ne: null },
                    timestamp: { $exists: true, $ne: null },
                    values: { $exists: true }
                }
            }
        ];
        
        const changeStream = collection.watch(pipeline, {
            fullDocument: 'updateLookup'
        });
        
        this.dataStreams.set(deviceType, changeStream);
        
        // 处理数据
        changeStream.on('change', async (change) => {
            await this.processDeviceData(change, deviceType);
        });
        
        changeStream.on('error', (error) => {
            console.error(`Error in device data stream for ${deviceType}:`, error);
        });
        
        console.log(`Started device data stream for ${deviceType}`);
    }
    
    async watchForNewCollections() {
        const db = this.client.db('iot');
        const adminDb = this.client.db('admin');
        
        // 监听集合创建事件
        const changeStream = db.watch([
            {
                $match: {
                    operationType: 'create'
                }
            }
        ]);
        
        changeStream.on('change', async (change) => {
            const collectionName = change.ns.coll;
            
            if (collectionName.startsWith('device_data_')) {
                console.log(`New device data collection detected: ${collectionName}`);
                await this.setupDeviceDataStream(collectionName);
            }
        });
    }
    
    async processDeviceData(change, deviceType) {
        const data = change.fullDocument;
        const deviceId = data.deviceId;
        const timestamp = data.timestamp;
        const values = data.values;
        
        // 更新设备状态
        await this.updateDeviceState(deviceId, deviceType, values, timestamp);
        
        // 检查警报条件
        await this.checkAlerts(deviceId, deviceType, values, timestamp);
        
        // 窗口聚合
        await this.addToProcessingWindow(deviceId, deviceType, values, timestamp);
        
        // 实时分析
        await this.realtimeAnalysis(deviceId, deviceType, values, timestamp);
        
        // 记录处理
        await this.recordDataProcessing(deviceId, deviceType, data);
    }
    
    async updateDeviceState(deviceId, deviceType, values, timestamp) {
        // 获取当前状态
        let state = this.deviceStates.get(deviceId);
        
        if (!state) {
            state = {
                deviceId,
                deviceType,
                lastUpdate: timestamp,
                values: {},
                history: [],
                metadata: {
                    firstSeen: timestamp,
                    updateCount: 0
                }
            };
        }
        
        // 更新值
        Object.entries(values).forEach(([key, value]) => {
            state.values[key] = {
                value,
                timestamp,
                previous: state.values[key]?.value
            };
        });
        
        // 记录历史（最近100条）
        state.history.push({
            timestamp,
            values,
            processedAt: new Date()
        });
        
        if (state.history.length > 100) {
            state.history = state.history.slice(-100);
        }
        
        state.lastUpdate = timestamp;
        state.metadata.updateCount++;
        
        // 保存状态
        this.deviceStates.set(deviceId, state);
        
        // 定期持久化
        if (state.metadata.updateCount % 100 === 0) {
            await this.persistDeviceState(state);
        }
    }
    
    async persistDeviceState(state) {
        // 持久化设备状态到数据库
        const db = this.client.db('iot');
        
        await db.collection('device_states').updateOne(
            { deviceId: state.deviceId },
            {
                $set: {
                    ...state,
                    persistedAt: new Date()
                },
                $setOnInsert: {
                    createdAt: new Date()
                }
            },
            { upsert: true }
        );
    }
    
    async checkAlerts(deviceId, deviceType, values, timestamp) {
        // 获取设备警报规则
        const rules = await this.getAlertRules(deviceId, deviceType);
        
        for (const rule of rules) {
            const shouldAlert = this.evaluateAlertRule(rule, values, timestamp);
            
            if (shouldAlert) {
                await this.triggerAlert(deviceId, rule, values, timestamp);
            }
        }
    }
    
    async getAlertRules(deviceId, deviceType) {
        const db = this.client.db('iot');
        
        // 获取设备特定的规则
        const deviceRules = await db.collection('alert_rules').find({
            $or: [
                { deviceId: deviceId },
                { deviceType: deviceType },
                { appliesToAll: true }
            ],
            enabled: true
        }).toArray();
        
        return deviceRules;
    }
    
    evaluateAlertRule(rule, values, timestamp) {
        // 评估警报规则
        
        const { conditions, operator = 'AND' } = rule;
        
        if (!conditions || conditions.length === 0) {
            return false;
        }
        
        const conditionResults = conditions.map(condition => {
            const { field, operator: op, value, window } = condition;
            
            const currentValue = values[field];
            if (currentValue === undefined) {
                return false;
            }
            
            // 检查窗口条件
            if (window) {
                // 需要检查一段时间内的值
                // 简化实现：只检查当前值
            }
            
            // 评估操作符
            switch (op) {
                case '>':
                    return currentValue > value;
                case '>=':
                    return currentValue >= value;
                case '<':
                    return currentValue < value;
                case '<=':
                    return currentValue <= value;
                case '==':
                    return currentValue === value;
                case '!=':
                    return currentValue !== value;
                case 'between':
                    return currentValue >= value.min && currentValue <= value.max;
                default:
                    return false;
            }
        });
        
        // 应用逻辑操作符
        if (operator === 'AND') {
            return conditionResults.every(r => r);
        } else if (operator === 'OR') {
            return conditionResults.some(r => r);
        }
        
        return false;
    }
    
    async triggerAlert(deviceId, rule, values, timestamp) {
        const alertId = `alert-${deviceId}-${Date.now()}`;
        
        const alert = {
            alertId,
            deviceId,
            ruleId: rule._id,
            ruleName: rule.name,
            severity: rule.severity,
            values,
            timestamp,
            triggeredAt: new Date(),
            status: 'active',
            acknowledged: false,
            acknowledgedBy: null,
            acknowledgedAt: null
        };
        
        // 存储警报
        this.alerts.set(alertId, alert);
        
        // 持久化
        await this.persistAlert(alert);
        
        // 发送通知
        await this.sendAlertNotification(alert);
        
        // 执行动作
        await this.executeAlertActions(alert, rule.actions);
        
        console.log(`Alert triggered: ${rule.name} for device ${deviceId}`);
    }
    
    async persistAlert(alert) {
        const db = this.client.db('iot');
        
        await db.collection('alerts').insertOne(alert);
    }
    
    async sendAlertNotification(alert) {
        // 发送警报通知
        // 可以实现邮件、短信、推送等
        
        console.log(`Sending alert notification: ${alert.ruleName} (${alert.severity})`);
    }
    
    async executeAlertActions(alert, actions) {
        if (!actions || actions.length === 0) {
            return;
        }
        
        for (const action of actions) {
            try {
                switch (action.type) {
                    case 'webhook':
                        await this.callWebhook(action.url, alert);
                        break;
                    case 'command':
                        await this.sendDeviceCommand(alert.deviceId, action.command);
                        break;
                    case 'log':
                        await this.logAlertAction(alert, action);
                        break;
                }
            } catch (error) {
                console.error(`Failed to execute alert action ${action.type}:`, error);
            }
        }
    }
    
    async callWebhook(url, alert) {
        // 调用Webhook
        // 实际实现使用HTTP客户端
        console.log(`Calling webhook ${url} for alert ${alert.alertId}`);
    }
    
    async sendDeviceCommand(deviceId, command) {
        // 发送命令到设备
        const db = this.client.db('iot');
        
        await db.collection('device_commands').insertOne({
            deviceId,
            command,
            sentAt: new Date(),
            status: 'pending'
        });
        
        console.log(`Sent command to device ${deviceId}: ${command}`);
    }
    
    async setupAlertStream() {
        // 监听警报确认和解决
        const db = this.client.db('iot');
        
        const changeStream = db.collection('alerts').watch([
            {
                $match: {
                    operationType: 'update',
                    'updateDescription.updatedFields.status': { $exists: true }
                }
            }
        ], {
            fullDocument: 'updateLookup'
        });
        
        changeStream.on('change', async (change) => {
            const alert = change.fullDocument;
            
            if (alert.status === 'acknowledged' || alert.status === 'resolved') {
                // 更新内存中的警报状态
                const memoryAlert = this.alerts.get(alert.alertId);
                if (memoryAlert) {
                    memoryAlert.status = alert.status;
                    memoryAlert.acknowledged = alert.acknowledged;
                    memoryAlert.acknowledgedBy = alert.acknowledgedBy;
                    memoryAlert.acknowledgedAt = alert.acknowledgedAt;
                }
                
                // 记录状态变更
                await this.recordAlertStatusChange(alert);
            }
        });
    }
    
    async setupDeviceStatusStream() {
        // 监听设备状态更新
        const db = this.client.db('iot');
        
        const changeStream = db.collection('device_status').watch([
            {
                $match: {
                    operationType: { $in: ['insert', 'update'] }
                }
            }
        ], {
            fullDocument: 'updateLookup'
        });
        
        changeStream.on('change', async (change) => {
            const status = change.fullDocument;
            const deviceId = status.deviceId;
            
            // 更新设备状态
            let state = this.deviceStates.get(deviceId);
            if (state) {
                state.connectionStatus = status.connected ? 'online' : 'offline';
                state.lastStatusUpdate = new Date();
                
                if (!status.connected) {
                    // 设备离线，检查是否应该触发警报
                    await this.checkDeviceOfflineAlert(deviceId, state);
                }
            }
        });
    }
    
    async checkDeviceOfflineAlert(deviceId, state) {
        // 检查设备离线时间
        const offlineDuration = Date.now() - state.lastUpdate.getTime();
        
        if (offlineDuration > 5 * 60 * 1000) { // 离线超过5分钟
            const rule = {
                _id: 'device-offline-auto',
                name: 'Device Offline',
                severity: 'warning',
                conditions: [] // 设备状态条件
            };
            
            await this.triggerAlert(deviceId, rule, { offlineDuration }, new Date());
        }
    }
    
    // 窗口聚合处理
    async addToProcessingWindow(deviceId, deviceType, values, timestamp) {
        // 添加到处理窗口
        // 实际实现需要更复杂的时间窗口管理
        
        // 这里简化：每分钟聚合一次
        const windowKey = `window-${deviceId}-${Math.floor(timestamp.getTime() / 60000)}`;
        
        // 在实际实现中，这里会有更复杂的时间窗口逻辑
        // 包括窗口滑动、重叠窗口处理等
    }
    
    async realtimeAnalysis(deviceId, deviceType, values, timestamp) {
        // 实时分析
        // 可以包括：
        // 1. 异常检测
        // 2. 趋势分析
        // 3. 预测
        
        // 获取设备历史数据
        const state = this.deviceStates.get(deviceId);
        if (!state || state.history.length < 10) {
            return;
        }
        
        // 简单异常检测：检查值是否突然变化
        for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(values)) {
            const previous = state.values[key]?.previous;
            
            if (previous !== undefined) {
                const change = Math.abs(value - previous);
                const changePercent = (change / Math.abs(previous)) * 100;
                
                if (changePercent > 50) { // 变化超过50%
                    // 可能异常
                    await this.recordPotentialAnomaly(deviceId, key, previous, value, timestamp);
                }
            }
        }
    }
    
    async recordPotentialAnomaly(deviceId, field, oldValue, newValue, timestamp) {
        const db = this.client.db('iot');
        
        await db.collection('potential_anomalies').insertOne({
            deviceId,
            field,
            oldValue,
            newValue,
            change: Math.abs(newValue - oldValue),
            changePercent: (Math.abs(newValue - oldValue) / Math.abs(oldValue)) * 100,
            timestamp,
            recordedAt: new Date(),
            reviewed: false
        });
    }
    
    async recordDataProcessing(deviceId, deviceType, data) {
        // 记录数据处理
        // 可以用于监控和调试
        
        const db = this.client.db('iot');
        
        await db.collection('data_processing_logs').insertOne({
            deviceId,
            deviceType,
            dataId: data._id,
            processedAt: new Date(),
            valuesCount: Object.keys(data.values || {}).length
        });
    }
    
    // 聚合任务
    startAggregationTasks() {
        // 每分钟聚合
        setInterval(async () => {
            await this.aggregateMinuteData();
        }, 60 * 1000);
        
        // 每5分钟聚合
        setInterval(async () => {
            await this.aggregateFiveMinuteData();
        }, 5 * 60 * 1000);
        
        // 每小时聚合
        setInterval(async () => {
            await this.aggregateHourlyData();
        }, 60 * 60 * 1000);
    }
    
    async aggregateMinuteData() {
        const now = new Date();
        const minuteStart = new Date(now.getFullYear(), now.getMonth(), now.getDate(), 
                                    now.getHours(), now.getMinutes(), 0, 0);
        
        console.log(`Aggregating minute data for ${minuteStart.toISOString()}`);
        
        // 实际实现需要聚合所有设备的数据
        // 这里简化处理
        
        const db = this.client.db('iot');
        
        // 示例：聚合温度数据
        const tempAggregation = await db.collection('device_data_temperature').aggregate([
            {
                $match: {
                    timestamp: {
                        $gte: minuteStart,
                        $lt: new Date(minuteStart.getTime() + 60000)
                    }
                }
            },
            {
                $group: {
                    _id: '$deviceId',
                    avgTemp: { $avg: '$values.temperature' },
                    maxTemp: { $max: '$values.temperature' },
                    minTemp: { $min: '$values.temperature' },
                    count: { $sum: 1 }
                }
            }
        ]).toArray();
        
        // 保存聚合结果
        if (tempAggregation.length > 0) {
            await db.collection('aggregated_minute_temperature').insertOne({
                timestamp: minuteStart,
                aggregation: tempAggregation,
                deviceCount: tempAggregation.length,
                aggregatedAt: new Date()
            });
        }
    }
    
    async aggregateFiveMinuteData() {
        // 5分钟聚合
        console.log('Aggregating 5-minute data');
    }
    
    async aggregateHourlyData() {
        // 小时聚合
        console.log('Aggregating hourly data');
    }
    
    // 清理任务
    startCleanupTasks() {
        // 定期清理旧数据
        setInterval(async () => {
            await this.cleanupOldData();
        }, 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000); // 每天
    }
    
    async cleanupOldData() {
        const db = this.client.db('iot');
        const thirtyDaysAgo = new Date(Date.now() - 30 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000);
        
        // 清理旧原始数据（保留汇总数据）
        await db.collection('device_data_temperature').deleteMany({
            timestamp: { $lt: thirtyDaysAgo }
        });
        
        // 清理旧日志
        await db.collection('data_processing_logs').deleteMany({
            processedAt: { $lt: thirtyDaysAgo }
        });
        
        console.log('Cleaned up old IoT data');
    }
    
    // API方法
    async getDeviceState(deviceId) {
        return this.deviceStates.get(deviceId);
    }
    
    async getActiveAlerts(deviceId = null) {
        const alerts = Array.from(this.alerts.values());
        
        if (deviceId) {
            return alerts.filter(alert => 
                alert.deviceId === deviceId && 
                alert.status === 'active'
            );
        }
        
        return alerts.filter(alert => alert.status === 'active');
    }
    
    async acknowledgeAlert(alertId, userId) {
        const alert = this.alerts.get(alertId);
        
        if (!alert) {
            throw new Error(`Alert ${alertId} not found`);
        }
        
        alert.status = 'acknowledged';
        alert.acknowledged = true;
        alert.acknowledgedBy = userId;
        alert.acknowledgedAt = new Date();
        
        // 更新数据库
        const db = this.client.db('iot');
        await db.collection('alerts').updateOne(
            { alertId },
            {
                $set: {
                    status: 'acknowledged',
                    acknowledged: true,
                    acknowledgedBy: userId,
                    acknowledgedAt: new Date()
                }
            }
        );
        
        return alert;
    }
    
    async getDeviceHistory(deviceId, startTime, endTime) {
        const db = this.client.db('iot');
        
        // 查找设备类型
        const state = this.deviceStates.get(deviceId);
        if (!state) {
            return [];
        }
        
        const collectionName = `device_data_${state.deviceType}`;
        
        const history = await db.collection(collectionName).find({
            deviceId,
            timestamp: {
                $gte: startTime,
                $lte: endTime
            }
        }).sort({ timestamp: 1 }).toArray();
        
        return history;
    }
    
    async getDeviceStatistics(deviceId, period = 'day') {
        // 获取设备统计
        const state = this.deviceStates.get(deviceId);
        if (!state) {
            return null;
        }
        
        const db = this.client.db('iot');
        
        // 根据时间段选择聚合集合
        let aggregationCollection;
        switch (period) {
            case 'minute':
                aggregationCollection = 'aggregated_minute_temperature';
                break;
            case 'hour':
                aggregationCollection = 'aggregated_hourly_temperature';
                break;
            case 'day':
                aggregationCollection = 'aggregated_daily_temperature';
                break;
            default:
                aggregationCollection = 'aggregated_daily_temperature';
        }
        
        // 查询设备聚合数据
        const stats = await db.collection(aggregationCollection).find({
            'aggregation._id': deviceId
        }).sort({ timestamp: -1 }).limit(100).toArray();
        
        return {
            deviceId,
            deviceType: state.deviceType,
            currentState: state.values,
            statistics: stats,
            lastUpdate: state.lastUpdate
        };
    }
    
    // 批量设备操作
    async batchUpdateDeviceConfig(deviceIds, config) {
        // 批量更新设备配置
        const db = this.client.db('iot');
        
        await db.collection('device_configs').updateMany(
            { deviceId: { $in: deviceIds } },
            { $set: config }
        );
        
        // 发送配置更新命令
        for (const deviceId of deviceIds) {
            await this.sendDeviceCommand(deviceId, {
                type: 'config_update',
                config
            });
        }
        
        return { updated: deviceIds.length };
    }
}

// 物联网仪表板实时更新
class IoTDashboard {
    constructor(iotProcessor, wss) {
        this.iotProcessor = iotProcessor;
        this.wss = wss;
        this.dashboardConnections = new Map(); // dashboardId -> connections
        this.subscriptions = new Map(); // connectionId -> subscriptions
        
        this.setupWebSocketServer();
    }
    
    setupWebSocketServer() {
        this.wss.on('connection', (ws, request) => {
            const connectionId = this.generateConnectionId();
            
            console.log(`New dashboard connection: ${connectionId}`);
            
            // 存储连接
            ws.connectionId = connectionId;
            this.subscriptions.set(connectionId, new Set());
            
            // 发送连接确认
            ws.send(JSON.stringify({
                type: 'connected',
                connectionId,
                timestamp: new Date().toISOString()
            }));
            
            // 处理消息
            ws.on('message', async (message) => {
                await this.handleDashboardMessage(connectionId, ws, message);
            });
            
            // 清理断开连接
            ws.on('close', () => {
                this.subscriptions.delete(connectionId);
                console.log(`Dashboard connection closed: ${connectionId}`);
            });
            
            ws.on('error', (error) => {
                console.error(`Dashboard connection error ${connectionId}:`, error);
                this.subscriptions.delete(connectionId);
            });
        });
    }
    
    generateConnectionId() {
        return `conn-${Date.now()}-${Math.random().toString(36).substr(2, 9)}`;
    }
    
    async handleDashboardMessage(connectionId, ws, message) {
        try {
            const data = JSON.parse(message);
            
            switch (data.type) {
                case 'subscribe':
                    await this.handleSubscribe(connectionId, ws, data);
                    break;
                    
                case 'unsubscribe':
                    await this.handleUnsubscribe(connectionId, data);
                    break;
                    
                case 'command':
                    await this.handleCommand(connectionId, data);
                    break;
                    
                case 'query':
                    await this.handleQuery(connectionId, ws, data);
                    break;
                    
                default:
                    console.warn(`Unknown message type from ${connectionId}:`, data.type);
            }
        } catch (error) {
            console.error(`Error handling message from ${connectionId}:`, error);
            
            ws.send(JSON.stringify({
                type: 'error',
                error: error.message,
                timestamp: new Date().toISOString()
            }));
        }
    }
    
    async handleSubscribe(connectionId, ws, data) {
        const { deviceId, metrics, updateInterval = 1000 } = data;
        
        // 验证设备存在
        const deviceState = this.iotProcessor.getDeviceState(deviceId);
        if (!deviceState) {
            throw new Error(`Device ${deviceId} not found`);
        }
        
        // 添加订阅
        const subscriptions = this.subscriptions.get(connectionId);
        subscriptions.add({
            deviceId,
            metrics,
            updateInterval,
            lastUpdate: 0
        });
        
        // 发送当前状态
        const currentData = await this.getDeviceCurrentData(deviceId, metrics);
        
        ws.send(JSON.stringify({
            type: 'device_update',
            deviceId,
            data: currentData,
            timestamp: new Date().toISOString()
        }));
        
        // 开始定期更新
        this.startDeviceUpdates(connectionId, ws, deviceId, metrics, updateInterval);
        
        console.log(`Subscribed ${connectionId} to device ${deviceId}`);
    }
    
    async getDeviceCurrentData(deviceId, metrics) {
        const state = this.iotProcessor.getDeviceState(deviceId);
        if (!state) {
            return {};
        }
        
        const data = {};
        
        if (metrics === 'all') {
            // 所有指标
            Object.assign(data, state.values);
        } else if (Array.isArray(metrics)) {
            // 特定指标
            metrics.forEach(metric => {
                if (state.values[metric]) {
                    data[metric] = state.values[metric];
                }
            });
        }
        
        return {
            ...data,
            lastUpdate: state.lastUpdate,
            deviceStatus: state.connectionStatus || 'unknown'
        };
    }
    
    startDeviceUpdates(connectionId, ws, deviceId, metrics, interval) {
        // 定期发送设备更新
        const updateKey = `${connectionId}:${deviceId}`;
        
        const updateInterval = setInterval(async () => {
            if (!this.subscriptions.has(connectionId)) {
                // 连接已关闭，清理
                clearInterval(updateInterval);
                return;
            }
            
            const subscriptions = this.subscriptions.get(connectionId);
            const subscription = Array.from(subscriptions).find(sub => 
                sub.deviceId === deviceId
            );
            
            if (!subscription) {
                // 订阅已取消
                clearInterval(updateInterval);
                return;
            }
            
            // 获取最新数据
            const data = await this.getDeviceCurrentData(deviceId, metrics);
            
            // 检查数据是否有变化
            const dataString = JSON.stringify(data);
            const lastDataString = subscription.lastDataString;
            
            if (dataString !== lastDataString) {
                // 数据有变化，发送更新
                ws.send(JSON.stringify({
                    type: 'device_update',
                    deviceId,
                    data,
                    timestamp: new Date().toISOString()
                }));
                
                subscription.lastDataString = dataString;
                subscription.lastUpdate = Date.now();
            }
            
        }, interval);
        
        // 存储定时器引用以便清理
        if (!ws.updateIntervals) {
            ws.updateIntervals = new Map();
        }
        ws.updateIntervals.set(updateKey, updateInterval);
    }
    
    async handleUnsubscribe(connectionId, data) {
        const { deviceId } = data;
        const subscriptions = this.subscriptions.get(connectionId);
        
        if (subscriptions) {
            // 移除订阅
            for (const subscription of subscriptions) {
                if (subscription.deviceId === deviceId) {
                    subscriptions.delete(subscription);
                    break;
                }
            }
            
            // 清理定时器
            const ws = this.getConnectionWebSocket(connectionId);
            if (ws && ws.updateIntervals) {
                const updateKey = `${connectionId}:${deviceId}`;
                const interval = ws.updateIntervals.get(updateKey);
                if (interval) {
                    clearInterval(interval);
                    ws.updateIntervals.delete(updateKey);
                }
            }
            
            console.log(`Unsubscribed ${connectionId} from device ${deviceId}`);
        }
    }
    
    async handleCommand(connectionId, data) {
        const { deviceId, command, parameters } = data;
        
        // 验证设备
        const deviceState = this.iotProcessor.getDeviceState(deviceId);
        if (!deviceState) {
            throw new Error(`Device ${deviceId} not found`);
        }
        
        // 发送命令
        await this.iotProcessor.sendDeviceCommand(deviceId, {
            type: command,
            ...parameters,
            issuedBy: connectionId,
            issuedAt: new Date()
        });
        
        console.log(`Command sent to device ${deviceId}: ${command}`);
    }
    
    async handleQuery(connectionId, ws, data) {
        const { queryType, parameters } = data;
        
        let result;
        
        switch (queryType) {
            case 'device_list':
                result = await this.getDeviceList(parameters);
                break;
                
            case 'device_history':
                result = await this.getDeviceHistory(parameters);
                break;
                
            case 'alerts':
                result = await this.getAlerts(parameters);
                break;
                
            case 'statistics':
                result = await this.getStatistics(parameters);
                break;
                
            default:
                throw new Error(`Unknown query type: ${queryType}`);
        }
        
        ws.send(JSON.stringify({
            type: 'query_result',
            queryType,
            result,
            timestamp: new Date().toISOString()
        }));
    }
    
    async getDeviceList(parameters) {
        const { deviceType, status } = parameters || {};
        
        const devices = [];
        
        for (const [deviceId, state] of this.iotProcessor.deviceStates.entries()) {
            if (deviceType && state.deviceType !== deviceType) {
                continue;
            }
            
            if (status && state.connectionStatus !== status) {
                continue;
            }
            
            devices.push({
                deviceId,
                deviceType: state.deviceType,
                lastUpdate: state.lastUpdate,
                connectionStatus: state.connectionStatus || 'unknown',
                values: state.values
            });
        }
        
        return devices;
    }
    
    async getDeviceHistory(parameters) {
        const { deviceId, startTime, endTime, limit = 1000 } = parameters;
        
        if (!deviceId) {
            throw new Error('Device ID is required');
        }
        
        return await this.iotProcessor.getDeviceHistory(
            deviceId, 
            new Date(startTime), 
            new Date(endTime)
        );
    }
    
    async getAlerts(parameters) {
        const { deviceId, status, severity, limit = 100 } = parameters || {};
        
        let alerts = await this.iotProcessor.getActiveAlerts(deviceId || null);
        
        if (status) {
            alerts = alerts.filter(alert => alert.status === status);
        }
        
        if (severity) {
            alerts = alerts.filter(alert => alert.severity === severity);
        }
        
        return alerts.slice(0, limit);
    }
    
    async getStatistics(parameters) {
        const { deviceId, period = 'day' } = parameters;
        
        if (!deviceId) {
            throw new Error('Device ID is required');
        }
        
        return await this.iotProcessor.getDeviceStatistics(deviceId, period);
    }
    
    getConnectionWebSocket(connectionId) {
        // 在实际实现中，需要存储连接映射
        // 这里简化处理
        return null;
    }
    
    // 警报广播
    async broadcastAlert(alert) {
        // 向所有订阅了相关设备的连接广播警报
        
        for (const [connectionId, subscriptions] of this.subscriptions.entries()) {
            for (const subscription of subscriptions) {
                if (subscription.deviceId === alert.deviceId) {
                    const ws = this.getConnectionWebSocket(connectionId);
                    if (ws) {
                        ws.send(JSON.stringify({
                            type: 'alert',
                            alert,
                            timestamp: new Date().toISOString()
                        }));
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
    
    // 设备状态广播
    async broadcastDeviceStatus(deviceId, status) {
        // 广播设备状态变化
        
        for (const [connectionId, subscriptions] of this.subscriptions.entries()) {
            for (const subscription of subscriptions) {
                if (subscription.deviceId === deviceId) {
                    const ws = this.getConnectionWebSocket(connectionId);
                    if (ws) {
                        ws.send(JSON.stringify({
                            type: 'device_status',
                            deviceId,
                            status,
                            timestamp: new Date().toISOString()
                        }));
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

6. 性能优化与最佳实践 ​

6.1 Change Streams 性能优化策略 ​

javascript
// Change Streams 性能优化最佳实践
const changeStreamsPerformance = {
    // 1. 连接和网络优化
    connectionOptimization: {
        connectionPooling: {
            recommendation: "重用MongoDB连接，避免为每个Change Stream创建新连接",
            implementation: `
                // 使用连接池
                const client = new MongoClient(uri, {
                    maxPoolSize: 100,        // 最大连接数
                    minPoolSize: 10,         // 最小连接数
                    maxIdleTimeMS: 30000,    // 空闲连接超时
                    waitQueueTimeoutMS: 10000 // 等待连接超时
                });
            `,
            benefit: "减少连接建立开销，提高资源利用率"
        },
        
        keepAlive: {
            recommendation: "启用TCP Keep-Alive",
            implementation: `
                const client = new MongoClient(uri, {
                    socketTimeoutMS: 30000,
                    connectTimeoutMS: 10000,
                    keepAlive: true,
                    keepAliveInitialDelay: 300000
                });
            `,
            benefit: "防止网络连接超时断开"
        }
    },
    
    // 2. 事件处理优化
    eventProcessingOptimization: {
        batching: {
            recommendation: "批量处理事件，减少处理开销",
            implementation: `
                let batch = [];
                const BATCH_SIZE = 100;
                const BATCH_TIMEOUT = 1000; // 1秒
                
                changeStream.on('change', (change) => {
                    batch.push(change);
                    
                    if (batch.length >= BATCH_SIZE) {
                        processBatch(batch);
                        batch = [];
                    }
                });
                
                // 定时处理
                setInterval(() => {
                    if (batch.length > 0) {
                        processBatch(batch);
                        batch = [];
                    }
                }, BATCH_TIMEOUT);
            `,
            benefit: "减少处理调用次数，提高吞吐量"
        },
        
        parallelProcessing: {
            recommendation: "并行处理独立事件",
            implementation: `
                const workerPool = new WorkerPool(4); // 4个工作线程
                
                changeStream.on('change', async (change) => {
                    // 根据文档ID分片到不同工作线程
                    const shardKey = hash(change.documentKey) % 4;
                    await workerPool.submit(shardKey, () => processChange(change));
                });
            `,
            benefit: "提高CPU利用率，降低延迟"
        },
        
        asyncProcessing: {
            recommendation: "使用异步非阻塞处理",
            implementation: `
                changeStream.on('change', (change) => {
                    // 立即确认事件，异步处理
                    process.nextTick(() => {
                        processChangeAsync(change).catch(console.error);
                    });
                });
            `,
            benefit: "避免阻塞事件循环，提高响应性"
        }
    },
    
    // 3. 内存和资源优化
    memoryOptimization: {
        backpressureHandling: {
            recommendation: "实施背压控制，防止内存溢出",
            implementation: `
                let processing = false;
                const queue = [];
                const MAX_QUEUE_SIZE = 10000;
                
                changeStream.on('change', (change) => {
                    if (queue.length >= MAX_QUEUE_SIZE) {
                        // 队列满，暂停Change Stream
                        changeStream.pause();
                        return;
                    }
                    
                    queue.push(change);
                    
                    if (!processing) {
                        processing = true;
                        processQueue();
                    }
                });
                
                async function processQueue() {
                    while (queue.length > 0) {
                        const change = queue.shift();
                        await processChange(change);
                        
                        // 恢复Change Stream（如果需要）
                        if (queue.length < MAX_QUEUE_SIZE / 2 && changeStream.isPaused()) {
                            changeStream.resume();
                        }
                    }
                    processing = false;
                }
            `,
            benefit: "防止内存耗尽，保证系统稳定性"
        },
        
        eventFiltering: {
            recommendation: "在数据库端过滤事件，减少网络传输",
            implementation: `
                // 使用聚合管道过滤
                const pipeline = [
                    { $match: { 
                        operationType: { $in: ['insert', 'update'] },
                        'fullDocument.status': 'active'
                    }}
                ];
                
                const changeStream = collection.watch(pipeline);
            `,
            benefit: "减少不必要的数据传输，降低网络开销"
        }
    },
    
    // 4. 恢复和可靠性优化
    recoveryOptimization: {
        checkpointFrequency: {
            recommendation: "优化检查点频率，平衡恢复时间和性能",
            implementation: `
                let eventCount = 0;
                const CHECKPOINT_INTERVAL = 1000; // 每1000个事件
                
                changeStream.on('change', async (change) => {
                    eventCount++;
                    
                    // 处理事件...
                    
                    if (eventCount % CHECKPOINT_INTERVAL === 0) {
                        await saveCheckpoint(change._id);
                    }
                });
            `,
            benefit: "快速恢复，减少重复处理"
        },
        
        resumeTokenStorage: {
            recommendation: "使用快速存储保存恢复令牌",
            implementation: `
                // 使用Redis存储恢复令牌
                const redis = require('redis');
                const redisClient = redis.createClient();
                
                async function saveResumeToken(streamId, token) {
                    await redisClient.set(
                        `changestream:${streamId}:resume_token`,
                        token._data
                    );
                }
                
                async function loadResumeToken(streamId) {
                    const tokenData = await redisClient.get(
                        `changestream:${streamId}:resume_token`
                    );
                    return tokenData ? { _data: tokenData } : null;
                }
            `,
            benefit: "快速访问恢复令牌，减少恢复时间"
        }
    },
    
    // 5. 监控和调优
    monitoringAndTuning: {
        metricsCollection: {
            recommendation: "收集关键性能指标",
            implementation: `
                const metrics = {
                    eventsProcessed: 0,
                    eventsPerSecond: 0,
                    processingLatency: [],
                    queueLength: 0,
                    errors: 0
                };
                
                // 定期计算每秒事件数
                setInterval(() => {
                    metrics.eventsPerSecond = 
                        metrics.eventsProcessed / 5; // 5秒窗口
                    metrics.eventsProcessed = 0;
                    
                    console.log('Metrics:', metrics);
                }, 5000);
            `,
            benefit: "了解性能瓶颈，指导优化"
        },
        
        adaptiveBatching: {
            recommendation: "根据负载动态调整批处理大小",
            implementation: `
                let batchSize = 100;
                let processingTime = 0;
                
                // 根据处理时间调整批大小
                setInterval(() => {
                    if (processingTime > 1000) {
                        // 处理时间太长，减小批大小
                        batchSize = Math.max(10, batchSize / 2);
                    } else if (processingTime < 100) {
                        // 处理时间短，增加批大小
                        batchSize = Math.min(1000, batchSize * 1.5);
                    }
                }, 10000);
            `,
            benefit: "自动适应负载变化，优化吞吐量"
        }
    }
};

// Change Streams 性能优化框架
class OptimizedChangeStreamProcessor {
    constructor(config) {
        this.config = {
            batchSize: config.batchSize || 100,
            maxQueueSize: config.maxQueueSize || 10000,
            checkpointInterval: config.checkpointInterval || 1000,
            maxConcurrency: config.maxConcurrency || 4,
            ...config
        };
        
        // 状态
        this.queue = [];
        this.processing = false;
        this.processingQueue = false;
        this.eventCount = 0;
        this.lastCheckpoint = null;
        
        // 工作线程池
        this.workerPool = this.createWorkerPool();
        
        // 指标
        this.metrics = {
            totalEvents: 0,
            eventsPerSecond: 0,
            avgProcessingTime: 0,
            queueLength: 0,
            errors: 0,
            lastUpdate: Date.now()
        };
        
        // 启动指标收集
        this.startMetricsCollection();
    }
    
    createWorkerPool() {
        // 创建工作线程池
        // 实际实现可能使用worker_threads或child_process
        const workers = [];
        
        for (let i = 0; i < this.config.maxConcurrency; i++) {
            workers.push({
                id: i,
                busy: false,
                taskQueue: []
            });
        }
        
        return {
            workers,
            
            async submit(task) {
                // 找到空闲或任务最少的worker
                let targetWorker = workers[0];
                
                for (const worker of workers) {
                    if (!worker.busy) {
                        targetWorker = worker;
                        break;
                    }
                    if (worker.taskQueue.length < targetWorker.taskQueue.length) {
                        targetWorker = worker;
                    }
                }
                
                // 提交任务
                return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
                    const taskWrapper = async () => {
                        targetWorker.busy = true;
                        try {
                            const result = await task();
                            resolve(result);
                        } catch (error) {
                            reject(error);
                        } finally {
                            targetWorker.busy = false;
                            
                            // 处理队列中的下一个任务
                            if (targetWorker.taskQueue.length > 0) {
                                const nextTask = targetWorker.taskQueue.shift();
                                nextTask();
                            }
                        }
                    };
                    
                    if (targetWorker.busy) {
                        targetWorker.taskQueue.push(taskWrapper);
                    } else {
                        taskWrapper();
                    }
                });
            }
        };
    }
    
    async processChangeStream(changeStream) {
        changeStream.on('change', (change) => {
            this.handleChangeEvent(change, changeStream);
        });
        
        changeStream.on('error', (error) => {
            this.handleStreamError(error, changeStream);
        });
        
        changeStream.on('close', () => {
            this.handleStreamClose(changeStream);
        });
    }
    
    handleChangeEvent(change, changeStream) {
        // 检查队列大小
        if (this.queue.length >= this.config.maxQueueSize) {
            // 队列满，暂停Change Stream
            changeStream.pause();
            
            // 记录背压事件
            this.recordBackpressure();
            
            // 设置恢复检查
            setTimeout(() => {
                if (this.queue.length < this.config.maxQueueSize / 2) {
                    changeStream.resume();
                }
            }, 1000);
            
            return;
        }
        
        // 添加到队列
        this.queue.push({
            change,
            receivedAt: Date.now()
        });
        
        // 更新指标
        this.metrics.totalEvents++;
        this.metrics.queueLength = this.queue.length;
        
        // 开始处理（如果还没开始）
        if (!this.processingQueue) {
            this.processingQueue = true;
            this.processQueue();
        }
        
        // 检查点
        this.eventCount++;
        if (this.eventCount % this.config.checkpointInterval === 0) {
            this.createCheckpoint(change._id);
        }
    }
    
    async processQueue() {
        while (this.queue.length > 0) {
            const batch = this.queue.splice(0, this.config.batchSize);
            
            if (batch.length === 0) {
                continue;
            }
            
            // 记录开始时间
            const startTime = Date.now();
            
            try {
                // 批量处理
                await this.processBatch(batch);
                
                // 更新处理时间指标
                const processingTime = Date.now() - startTime;
                this.updateProcessingTime(processingTime, batch.length);
                
                // 动态调整批大小
                this.adjustBatchSize(processingTime, batch.length);
                
            } catch (error) {
                console.error('Batch processing error:', error);
                this.metrics.errors++;
                
                // 错误处理：重试或放入死信队列
                await this.handleBatchError(batch, error);
            }
        }
        
        this.processingQueue = false;
    }
    
    async processBatch(batch) {
        // 使用工作线程池并行处理
        const tasks = batch.map(item => 
            () => this.processSingleChange(item.change)
        );
        
        // 并行执行，但限制并发数
        const results = [];
        for (let i = 0; i < tasks.length; i += this.config.maxConcurrency) {
            const chunk = tasks.slice(i, i + this.config.maxConcurrency);
            const chunkResults = await Promise.allSettled(
                chunk.map(task => this.workerPool.submit(task))
            );
            results.push(...chunkResults);
        }
        
        // 检查结果
        const failures = results.filter(r => r.status === 'rejected');
        if (failures.length > 0) {
            // 记录失败但继续处理
            console.warn(`${failures.length} tasks failed in batch`);
        }
    }
    
    async processSingleChange(change) {
        // 单个事件处理逻辑
        // 这应该由具体应用实现
        
        // 模拟处理时间
        await new Promise(resolve => 
            setTimeout(resolve, Math.random() * 10)
        );
        
        return { success: true };
    }
    
    updateProcessingTime(processingTime, batchSize) {
        // 更新平均处理时间
        const avgTimePerEvent = processingTime / batchSize;
        
        // 指数移动平均
        const alpha = 0.1; // 平滑因子
        this.metrics.avgProcessingTime = 
            alpha * avgTimePerEvent + 
            (1 - alpha) * (this.metrics.avgProcessingTime || avgTimePerEvent);
    }
    
    adjustBatchSize(processingTime, currentBatchSize) {
        // 根据处理时间动态调整批大小
        
        if (processingTime > 1000 && currentBatchSize > 10) {
            // 处理时间太长，减小批大小
            this.config.batchSize = Math.max(10, Math.floor(currentBatchSize * 0.8));
            console.log(`Reduced batch size to ${this.config.batchSize}`);
            
        } else if (processingTime < 100 && currentBatchSize < 1000) {
            // 处理时间短，增加批大小
            this.config.batchSize = Math.min(1000, Math.floor(currentBatchSize * 1.2));
            console.log(`Increased batch size to ${this.config.batchSize}`);
        }
    }
    
    async createCheckpoint(resumeToken) {
        try {
            this.lastCheckpoint = {
                resumeToken,
                timestamp: new Date(),
                eventCount: this.eventCount
            };
            
            // 保存检查点
            await this.saveCheckpoint(resumeToken);
            
            console.log(`Checkpoint created at event ${this.eventCount}`);
            
        } catch (error) {
            console.error('Failed to create checkpoint:', error);
        }
    }
    
    async saveCheckpoint(resumeToken) {
        // 保存检查点到持久化存储
        // 具体实现取决于存储后端
    }
    
    async loadCheckpoint() {
        // 从持久化存储加载检查点
        // 返回恢复令牌或null
        return null;
    }
    
    recordBackpressure() {
        // 记录背压事件
        console.warn(`Backpressure: queue at ${this.queue.length}/${this.config.maxQueueSize}`);
        
        // 可以发送警报或调整配置
    }
    
    async handleBatchError(batch, error) {
        // 批处理错误处理
        
        // 选项1：重试单个失败的事件
        for (const item of batch) {
            try {
                await this.processSingleChange(item.change);
            } catch (retryError) {
                // 重试失败，放入死信队列
                await this.sendToDeadLetterQueue(item.change, retryError);
            }
        }
        
        // 选项2：整个批重试（需要幂等性）
        // 选项3：记录错误并跳过
    }
    
    async sendToDeadLetterQueue(change, error) {
        // 发送到死信队列
        console.error('Sending to dead letter queue:', error.message);
        
        // 可以保存到数据库或消息队列
    }
    
    handleStreamError(error, changeStream) {
        console.error('Change stream error:', error);
        
        // 根据错误类型决定操作
        if (this.isResumableError(error)) {
            // 可恢复错误，尝试重新连接
            setTimeout(() => {
                console.log('Attempting to resume change stream');
                // 重新连接逻辑
            }, 5000);
        } else {
            // 不可恢复错误
            console.error('Fatal change stream error, stopping');
            // 可能需要重启整个处理器
        }
    }
    
    isResumableError(error) {
        // 判断错误是否可恢复
        const resumableErrors = [
            'network error',
            'timeout',
            'connection lost',
            'primary stepped down'
        ];
        
        return resumableErrors.some(resumable => 
            error.message.toLowerCase().includes(resumable)
        );
    }
    
    handleStreamClose(changeStream) {
        console.log('Change stream closed');
        
        // 清理资源
        this.queue = [];
        this.processingQueue = false;
    }
    
    startMetricsCollection() {
        // 定期收集和报告指标
        setInterval(() => {
            this.updateMetrics();
            this.reportMetrics();
        }, 5000);
    }
    
    updateMetrics() {
        const now = Date.now();
        const timeWindow = (now - this.metrics.lastUpdate) / 1000; // 秒
        
        if (timeWindow > 0) {
            this.metrics.eventsPerSecond = 
                this.metrics.totalEvents / timeWindow;
        }
        
        this.metrics.queueLength = this.queue.length;
        this.metrics.lastUpdate = now;
        this.metrics.totalEvents = 0; // 重置计数器
    }
    
    reportMetrics() {
        console.log('Performance Metrics:', {
            eventsPerSecond: this.metrics.eventsPerSecond.toFixed(2),
            avgProcessingTime: this.metrics.avgProcessingTime.toFixed(2),
            queueLength: this.metrics.queueLength,
            batchSize: this.config.batchSize,
            errors: this.metrics.errors
        });
        
        // 可以发送到监控系统
        this.sendMetricsToMonitoring();
    }
    
    sendMetricsToMonitoring() {
        // 发送指标到监控系统
        // 例如：Prometheus, Datadog, CloudWatch等
    }
    
    // 健康检查
    getHealthStatus() {
        const now = Date.now();
        const lastEventAge = this.lastCheckpoint 
            ? now - this.lastCheckpoint.timestamp.getTime()
            : Infinity;
        
        return {
            healthy: this.queue.length < this.config.maxQueueSize * 0.8,
            queueLength: this.queue.length,
            maxQueueSize: this.config.maxQueueSize,
            processingQueue: this.processingQueue,
            lastEventAge: lastEventAge / 1000, // 秒
            metrics: this.metrics
        };
    }
}

// Change Streams 限制应对策略
class ChangeStreamsLimitationHandler {
    constructor() {
        this.monitoringEnabled = true;
        this.alertThresholds = {
            oplogUsage: 0.8, // 80%
            eventLatency: 5000, // 5秒
            queueSize: 10000,
            errorRate: 0.01 // 1%
        };
    }
    
    async monitorAndHandleLimitations(changeStreamProcessor) {
        // 定期检查限制条件
        setInterval(async () => {
            await this.checkOplogUsage();
            await this.checkEventLatency(changeStreamProcessor);
            await this.checkQueueSize(changeStreamProcessor);
            await this.checkErrorRate(changeStreamProcessor);
        }, 60000); // 每分钟检查一次
    }
    
    async checkOplogUsage() {
        const adminDb = this.getAdminDb();
        
        try {
            const replInfo = await adminDb.command({ replSetGetStatus: 1 });
            
            // 计算oplog使用率
            // 这里需要根据实际情况调整
            const oplogUsage = 0; // 计算使用率
            
            if (oplogUsage > this.alertThresholds.oplogUsage) {
                await this.handleHighOplogUsage(oplogUsage);
            }
            
        } catch (error) {
            console.error('Failed to check oplog usage:', error);
        }
    }
    
    async handleHighOplogUsage(usage) {
        console.warn(`High oplog usage detected: ${(usage * 100).toFixed(2)}%`);
        
        // 措施：
        // 1. 增加oplog大小
        // 2. 加速事件处理
        // 3. 保存检查点
        // 4. 发送警报
        
        await this.sendAlert('high_oplog_usage', {
            usage,
            threshold: this.alertThresholds.oplogUsage,
            timestamp: new Date()
        });
    }
    
    async checkEventLatency(processor) {
        const metrics = processor.metrics;
        const avgProcessingTime = metrics.avgProcessingTime || 0;
        
        if (avgProcessingTime > this.alertThresholds.eventLatency) {
            await this.handleHighLatency(avgProcessingTime);
        }
    }
    
    async handleHighLatency(latency) {
        console.warn(`High event latency detected: ${latency}ms`);
        
        // 措施：
        // 1. 减小批处理大小
        // 2. 增加处理并发度
        // 3. 优化处理逻辑
        // 4. 发送警报
        
        await this.sendAlert('high_latency', {
            latency,
            threshold: this.alertThresholds.eventLatency,
            timestamp: new Date()
        });
    }
    
    async checkQueueSize(processor) {
        const queueLength = processor.queue?.length || 0;
        
        if (queueLength > this.alertThresholds.queueSize) {
            await this.handleLargeQueue(queueLength);
        }
    }
    
    async handleLargeQueue(queueLength) {
        console.warn(`Large queue detected: ${queueLength} items`);
        
        // 措施：
        // 1. 增加处理能力
        // 2. 暂停Change Stream（背压）
        // 3. 丢弃旧事件（如果允许）
        // 4. 发送警报
        
        await this.sendAlert('large_queue', {
            queueLength,
            threshold: this.alertThresholds.queueSize,
            timestamp: new Date()
        });
    }
    
    async checkErrorRate(processor) {
        const metrics = processor.metrics;
        const totalEvents = metrics.totalEvents || 1;
        const errors = metrics.errors || 0;
        const errorRate = errors / totalEvents;
        
        if (errorRate > this.alertThresholds.errorRate) {
            await this.handleHighErrorRate(errorRate, errors, totalEvents);
        }
    }
    
    async handleHighErrorRate(errorRate, errors, totalEvents) {
        console.warn(`High error rate detected: ${(errorRate * 100).toFixed(2)}% (${errors}/${totalEvents})`);
        
        // 措施：
        // 1. 检查错误原因
        // 2. 实现更健壮的错误处理
        // 3. 降低处理速度
        // 4. 发送警报
        
        await this.sendAlert('high_error_rate', {
            errorRate,
            errors,
            totalEvents,
            threshold: this.alertThresholds.errorRate,
            timestamp: new Date()
        });
    }
    
    async sendAlert(type, data) {
        // 发送警报
        // 可以实现邮件、Slack、SMS等
        
        console.log(`ALERT [${type}]:`, data);
    }
    
    getAdminDb() {
        // 获取admin数据库连接
        // 需要具体实现
        return null;
    }
    
    // 恢复策略
    async createRobustRecoveryStrategy(processor) {
        return {
            // 多级恢复令牌存储
            tokenStorage: {
                primary: 'memory', // 内存，快速访问
                secondary: 'redis', // Redis，持久化
                tertiary: 'database' // 数据库，长期存储
            },
            
            // 恢复策略
            strategies: [
                {
                    name: 'resume_token',
                    priority: 1,
                    condition: '恢复令牌有效且未过期',
                    action: '使用resumeAfter选项恢复'
                },
                {
                    name: 'start_after_token',
                    priority: 2,
                    condition: '有恢复令牌但可能包含重复',
                    action: '使用startAfter选项恢复'
                },
                {
                    name: 'operation_time',
                    priority: 3,
                    condition: '知道事件大致时间',
                    action: '使用startAtOperationTime选项恢复'
                },
                {
                    name: 'full_resync',
                    priority: 4,
                    condition: '无法恢复或数据损坏',
                    action: '从头开始重新同步'
                }
            ],
            
            // 恢复执行
            async executeRecovery() {
                for (const strategy of this.strategies) {
                    try {
                        const canUse = await this.canUseStrategy(strategy);
                        if (canUse) {
                            console.log(`Using recovery strategy: ${strategy.name}`);
                            await this.applyStrategy(strategy);
                            return true;
                        }
                    } catch (error) {
                        console.error(`Recovery strategy ${strategy.name} failed:`, error);
                    }
                }
                
                console.error('All recovery strategies failed');
                return false;
            }
        };
    }
}

8. 总结 ​

8.1 核心要点回顾 ​

MongoDB Change Streams 是一个强大的实时数据流处理工具，为构建响应式、事件驱动的应用程序提供了基础。以下是关键要点总结：

  1. 核心能力：

    • 实时监听数据库变化
    • 支持集合、数据库和部署级别的监听
    • 提供可恢复的游标机制
    • 支持复杂的事件过滤和转换

  2. 架构优势：

    • 基于oplog，高效可靠
    • 支持分片集群
    • 与MongoDB事务集成
    • 提供快照一致性

  3. 适用场景：

    • 实时推荐系统
    • 微服务数据同步
    • 物联网数据处理
    • 实时分析仪表板
    • 审计和合规性跟踪
    • 缓存失效和更新

8.2 最佳实践总结 ​

  1. 连接管理：

    • 重用MongoDB连接
    • 实施连接池
    • 配置适当的超时时间

  2. 错误处理：

    • 实现自动重连逻辑
    • 保存恢复令牌
    • 处理背压和队列溢出

  3. 性能优化：

    • 批量处理事件
    • 并行处理独立事件
    • 动态调整批处理大小
    • 监控关键性能指标

  4. 可靠性保障：

    • 定期保存检查点
    • 实现幂等操作
    • 设计故障恢复策略
    • 监控系统健康状况

8.3 未来发展方向 ​

MongoDB Change Streams 在持续演进中，未来可能的发展方向包括：

  1. 增强功能：

    • 更细粒度的事件过滤
    • 跨集群Change Streams
    • 增强的事务支持

  2. 性能改进：

    • 更高效的事件传输协议
    • 更好的压缩和批处理
    • 减少网络开销

  3. 生态系统集成：

    • 与更多流处理框架集成
    • 云原生部署优化
    • 无服务器函数集成

Change Streams 已成为现代数据驱动应用程序的关键组件，通过深入理解和正确应用，可以构建出高效、可靠、实时的数据处理系统。
